70533.title: Avengers: Doomsday
70533.synopsis: Universes collide and the Multiverse Saga begins its final chapter in Marvel Studios' Avengers: Doomsday. Beloved heroes from three distinct universes will be set on a deadly collision course and ultimately face an existential threat unlike anything they've ever encountered. This epic film will lay the foundation for the future of the Marvel Cinematic Universe.

71218.title: Clayface
71218.synopsis: CLAYFACE unravels one man's horrifying descent from rising Hollywood star to revenge-filled monster in a story that explores the loss of one's identity and humanity, corrosive love, and the dark underbelly of scientific ambition.
71218.cast: David Dencik, Naomi Ackie, Tom Rhys Harries

72478.title: Disney's Hexed
72478.synopsis: In Hexed, an impulsive and unconventional teenage girl named Billie (voice of Hailee Steinfeld) discovers secret magical abilities which, once unleashed, hurtle her into a spectacle-filled journey out of suburbia and into a vast witch realm called Hexe. Forced to team up with her cautious mother, Alice (voice of Rashida Jones), they uncover family mysteries that could change the world of witches forever. Directed by Fawn Veerasunthorn and Jason Hand, co-directed by Josie Trinidad, and produced by Roy Conli and Yvett Merino.

76238.title: The Odyssey
76238.synopsis:
Christopher Nolan's next film, THE ODYSSEY, is a mythic action epic shot across the world using brand new IMAX film technology. The film brings Homer's foundational saga to IMAX film screens for the first time and opens in theaters everywhere on July 17, 2026.

The Odyssey stars Matt Damon, Tom Holland, Anne Hathaway, Robert Pattinson and Lupita Nyong'o, with Zendaya and Charlize Theron.

The Odyssey is produced by Emma Thomas and Christopher Nolan for their company, Syncopy. The executive producer is Thomas Hayslip.
76238.advisory: AMC has been advised that this film contains sequences with flashing lights that may affect photosensitive viewers.
76238.cast: Anne Hathaway, Matt Damon, Tom Holland

76536.title: The Cat in the Hat
76536.synopsis: Meet the Cat in the Hat you don't know! In the wonderfully whimsical tradition of Dr. Seuss, THE CAT IN THE HAT, voiced by Bill Hader, comes to the big screen in his animated theatrical feature film debut, an all-new, epic adventure where mischief, magic and mayhem reign supreme.
76536.cast: Bill Hader, Paula Pell, Quinta Brunson, Xochitl Gomez

77032.title: Dune: Part Three
77032.synopsis:
From Warner Bros. Pictures and Legendary Pictures comes Dune: Part Three, bringing Academy Award-nominated filmmaker Denis Villeneuve’s epic trilogy to a breathtaking conclusion. 

Dune: Part Three is set nearly two decades after Paul Atreides seized control of the Imperium. Now a ruthless Emperor, Paul must face the consequences of his reign as old allies return, terrifying new threats emerge, and betrayal lurks in every shadow. Haunted by visions of Imperial collapse and the reappearance of his long-lost love, Paul is drawn into a sweeping conspiracy, with Chani at the heart of its unfolding mystery. As rebellion brews and enemies close in, Paul must confront the true cost of power and the fate of those he loves the most.

77249.title: Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping
77249.synopsis: THE HUNGER GAMES: SUNRISE ON THE REAPING will revisit the world of Panem 24 years before the events of The Hunger Games, starting on the morning of the reaping of the 50th Hunger Games, also known as the Second Quarter Quell.
77249.cast: Jesse Plemons, Joseph Zada, Ralph Fiennes

77282.title: Violent Night 2
77282.synopsis:
If you're nice, you get presents from the Big Guy. If you're naughty, you get justice.

David Harbour reprises his role as Santa Claus in a propulsive new chapter in yuletide mayhem from 87North--the powerhouse producers of Bullet Train, John Wick, The Fall Guy, Atomic Blonde and the Nobody franchise--and returning action director Tommy Wirkola.

In 2022's bare-knuckle holiday sensation, VIOLENT NIGHT, an embittered Santa, armed with lethal combat skills, took out a team of mercenaries to rescue a girl and her family. Now, not-so-jolly Saint Nick suits up again to take on a ruthless gangster (Emmy and Golden Globe nominee Jared Harris) terrorizing the merchants of the Silver Bell Mall.

But when Santa forgets the true meaning of Christmas, he finds himself in the heart of a lively mall community in desperate need of his help. Sapped of his magic, he'll need another way to take on the goons threatening the mall, and time is running out. Santa has to rediscover his faith in goodness and call in some last-minute reinforcements from the one person no baddie wants to tangle with: Mrs. Claus (Emmy and Golden Globe nominee Kristen Bell). 

Along with David Harbour, Jared Harris and Kristen Bell, the dynamic cast includes Emmy winning screen legend Joe Pantoliano (The Last of Us, The Sopranos), Daniela Melchior (Fast X, Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3), Andrew Bachelor (Greenland, The Walking Dead), and AEW professional wrestler Maxwell Friedman (The Iron Claw, Happy Gilmore 2).

VIOLENT NIGHT 2 is directed by returning filmmaker Tommy Wirkola and produced again by 87North founders Kelly McCormick and David Leitch. The film's returning screenwriters are Pat Casey and Josh Miller. Violent Night 2 will be released by Universal Pictures.
77282.cast: David Harbour, Jared Harris, Kristen Bell

77447.title: Street Fighter
77447.synopsis: Set in 1993, estranged Street Fighters Ryu and Ken Masters are thrown back into combat when the mysterious Chun-Li recruits them for the next World Warrior Tournament: a brutal clash of fists, fate, and fury. But behind this battle royale lies a deadly conspiracy that forces them to face off against each other and the demons of their past. And if they don't, it's GAME OVER!
77447.cast: Andrew Koji, Callina Liang, Noah Centineo

77466.title: River
77466.synopsis:
The sun is down.  The boat is dead.  There's no cell service.  And there's someone standing, staring, from both shores.  Written and directed by Joshua Giuliano, RIVER stars Jane Levy (Evil Dead), Jessica Rothe (Happy Death Day) and Max Mattern (Devil in Disguise: John Wayne Gacy) as three estranged siblings who reunite in their hometown after the death of their father. As they set out to scatter his ashes at his favorite spot on a remote river, the trip devolves into a waking nightmare. Dane DiLiegro (Prey) also stars in the film.

Currently with a 94% critics rating on Rotten Tomatoes, RIVER was acquired by Universal Pictures and Blumhouse Atomic Monster following an electrifying launch at Midnight Madness at the Toronto International Film Festival. This release establishes a meaningful, new collaboration between Universal Pictures, Blumhouse Atomic Monster, Independent Film Company and Shudder, bringing them together for the expanded theatrical release of Joshua Giuliano's debut feature. 

Universal Pictures, Blumhouse Atomic Monster and Independent Film Company present RIVER, a Shudder Original Production, in association with Upgrade. RIVER is produced by Spooky Pictures' Steven Schneider and Eat the Cat's Nick Antosca and Alex Hedlund. The film is executive produced by Allegheny Image Factory's Jeffrey Tinnell and Robert Tinnell, Upgrade's Matt Brodlie and Jonathan Kier, Ben Ross and Blumhouse Atomic Monster's Jason Blum.
77466.cast: Jane Levy, Jessica Rothe, Max Mattern

78614.title: Jumanji: Open World
78614.synopsis: This Christmas, Dwayne Johnson, Kevin Hart, Jack Black, and Karen Gillan are reunited in Jumanji: Open World, the hilarious final installment of the globally beloved action-adventure trilogy. Our heroes have escaped the perilous jungles of Jumanji before, but this time Jumanji breaks free of its console, unleashing its chaos into our world.
78614.cast: Dwayne Johnson, Jack Black, Kevin Hart

79095.title: Children of Blood and Bone
79095.synopsis: In the epic fantasy world of Orïsha, a young woman goes on a quest to reclaim the magic that was violently stolen from her people. She and her brother ally with the daughter and son of the king to fight back against his brutal rule. Directed by Gina Prince-Bythewood, CHILDREN OF BLOOD AND BONE features a stellar cast including Thuso Mbedu, Damson Idris, Amandla Stenberg, Tosin Cole, featuring Academy Award® nominee Cynthia Erivo, Lashana Lynch, Zackary Momoh, Richard Mofe-Damijo, Academy Award®  nominee Chiwetel Ejiofor, Academy Award®  winner Regina King, with Idris Elba and Academy Award®  winner Viola Davis.

79125.title: Digger
79125.synopsis: The most powerful man in the world embarks on a frantic mission to prove he is humanity's savior before the disaster he's unleashed destroys everything.

79305.title: Werwulf
79305.synopsis: Witness Robert Eggers’ most visceral and haunting experience yet. Focus Features presents WERWULF, a harrowing tale of devotion, damnation and the devil within.

79467.title: The Angry Birds Movie 3
79467.synopsis: This holiday season, one angry bird will face his greatest challenge yet, surviving fatherhood? while saving the world!

79697.title: Resident Evil
79697.synopsis: In an all-new story, Resident Evil follows Bryan (Austin Abrams), a medical courier who unwittingly finds himself in an action-packed, non-stop race for survival as one fateful, horrifying night collapses around him in chaos.
79697.advisory: AMC has been advised that this film contains sequences with flashing lights that may affect photosensitive viewers.

79853.title: Verity
79853.synopsis: Struggling writer Lowen Ashleigh is hired as a ghostwriter for renowned author Verity Crawford under mysterious circumstances, but her assignment takes a dark turn after discovering chilling autobiographical notes. Faced with a series of deadly family secrets, Lowen struggles to separate fiction from reality, while also blurring the lines with Verity's husband, Jeremy.
79853.cast: Anne Hathaway, Dakota Johnson, Josh Hartnett

79935.title: ZERO A.D.: The Birth of Christ
79935.synopsis: A brutal ruler fears a prophecy and orders the death of a child - one who will change history.
79935.cast: Ben Mendelsohn, Deva Cassel, Gael Garcia Bernal, Sam Worthington

80290.title: How to Rob a Bank
80290.synopsis: In HOW TO ROB A BANK, a crew of social media-savvy bank robbers broadcasts their daring heists, unaware that their growing viral fame has put them in the crosshairs of a veteran FBI agent and a brilliant software engineer. Despite the unlikely duo closing in, the crime ring pushes past their limits, putting everything on the line for their most ambitious heist yet.
80290.cast: Anna Sawai, Nicholas Hoult, Pete Davidson

80303.title: Other Mommy
80303.synopsis:
Can I go inside your heart?
 
From James Wan, one of the most influential architects of modern horror and the visionary behind M3GAN, Saw, Insidious and The Conjuring franchises--comes a terrifying, supernatural trip into the darkening world of a young girl as her family, and their home, are haunted by a sinister entity that is determined to take up residence inside her. But first, it needs to persuade her to let it in ...
 
Academy Award winner Jessica Chastain (It Chapter Two, The Eyes of Tammy Faye), Jay Duplass (Transparent, Industry), Arabella Olivia Clark (Springsteen: Deliver Me From Nowhere, The Hand that Rocks the Cradle) and Dichen Lachman (Severance) star in this chilling tale of terror, from Rob Savage, the bold genre director of the acclaimed films Host and The Boogeyman.

From Atomic Monster and Blumhouse, the film is from a screenplay by WGA award winner Nathan Elston, writer for the Emmy-winning sensation Succession, based on the New York Times bestselling novel Incidents Around the House by Josh Malerman (Bird Box).
 
The film is produced by James Wan and is executive produced by Michael Clear, Judson Scott, Macdara Kelleher, Rob Savage, Josh Malerman and Ryan Lewis. Alayna Glasthal is the executive overseeing the film for Atomic Monster.
80303.advisory: AMC has been advised that this film contains sequences with flashing lights that may affect photosensitive viewers.

80471.title: Whalefall
80471.synopsis: Following the death of his father (Josh Brolin), Jay Gardiner (Austin Abrams) goes diving off the central Coast of California in search of his remains, but is swallowed by a massive sperm whale. While trapped inside its belly with only one hour of oxygen left, Jay comes to realize that the hard-earned lessons his father imparted may be the key to his escape.

81142.title: The Third Parent
81142.synopsis: Based on the viral "creepypasta" series of internet-based stories from writer Elias Witherow, The Third Parent takes place amidst a Fourth of July celebration when a disturbing figure named Tommy Taffy emerges, disguising himself as a human to infiltrate a suburban neighborhood and impose authoritarian rule over an unsuspecting family.

81643.title: The Social Reckoning
81643.synopsis: Inspired by true events and the whistleblower who started the social media reckoning we?re seeing play out today, this Aaron Sorkin original screenplay is a companion piece to the hit film The Social Network and a true David and Goliath story. Frances Haugen (Madison), a young Facebook engineer, enlists the help of Jeff Horwitz (White), a Wall Street Journal reporter, to go on a dangerous journey that ends up blowing the whistle on the social network?s most guarded secrets.

81814.title: Space Cadet
81814.synopsis: When astronaut Celeste launches into space on her first solo mission, she leaves behind Robot, the guardian who raised her. Alone for the first time, each must confront what it means to let go. As Celeste faces unexpected dangers in the vast reaches of space, her memories become her only compass.

81847.title: Ghost Soldier
81847.synopsis: In the action-thriller GHOST SOLDIER, Jim Caviezel stars as Henry "Fitz" Fitzgerald, a solitary man with a mysterious past, living a quiet life off the grid in his hometown. But when a powerful foreign corporation descends on his community determined to seize his and his neighbors' land for a massive payday, Fitz takes action -- he's actually a former Special Forces soldier and advanced weapons developer. Armed with weapons no one has ever seen, a lifetime of lethal military training, and an unwavering code of justice, Fitz becomes the one thing his enemies never anticipated: a one-man war they can't win.
81847.cast: Beau Knapp, Jim Caviezel, Olivia Thirlby

81938.title: Ebenezer
81938.synopsis: This November, prepare to be ghosted. Johnny Depp is the deliciously unpleasant Ebenezer Scrooge in a thrilling reimagining of the most iconic ghost story of all time. On one unforgettable Christmas Eve, Ebenezer collides with his past, present, and future on a supernatural journey that will decide his ultimate fate. If you think you know his story, think again. Directed by Ti West and with a screenplay by Nathaniel Halpern, Ebenezer also stars Rupert Grint, Andrea Riseborough, Sam Claflin, Daisy Ridley, Arthur Conti, Ellie Bamber, Henry Lloyd-Hughes, Charlie Murphy, with Tramell Tillman and Ian McKellen.

82178.title: Sense and Sensibility
82178.synopsis: From Focus Features and Working Title comes an irresistible new take on Jane Austen?s iconic Sense and Sensibility: a charming, witty, and deeply relatable story of love and sisterhood starring Daisy Edgar-Jones and Esme Creed-Miles.

82510.title: Pendulum
82510.synopsis: Married couple Patrick (Gordon-Levitt) and Abigail (Dynevor) travel to a secluded New Mexico retreat seeking healing after a traumatic event. But as Abigail falls deeper under the influence of the retreat's enigmatic leader (Weaver), Patrick begins to suspect something far more sinister lurks beneath the group's spiritual promises. As paranoia spirals into terror, the couple uncovers a horrifying truth that may consume them both before they can escape.
82510.cast: Joseph Gordon-Levitt, Norman Reedus, Phoebe Dynevor

82570.title: Godzilla Minus Zero
82570.synopsis:
War reduced Japan to zero, and Godzilla plunged it into minus. Two years have passed since then, and the country has faced agonizing struggles to achieve recovery and finally reclaim its daily life.

Just as humanity managed to cling to a hard-won peace, a new threat strikes, crushing hope in an instant.
 
There is no third time. Everything ends here.

82629.title: Wildwood
82629.synopsis: It follows a girl?s desperate quest to save her baby brother, which becomes a high-stakes journey into a forbidden forest filled with enchanted creatures, unlikely allies and formidable adversaries, where an entire hidden realm hangs in the balance.
82629.cast: Carey Mulligan, Jacob Tremblay, Peyton Elizabeth Lee

82697.title: The Beekeeper 2
82697.synopsis: Now a wanted man, former government assassin Adam Clay continues his vendetta against those who wronged him.

82739.title: I Play Rocky
82739.synopsis: The film is an electrifying true story about an unknown actor with an unshakable belief that he wasn't just meant to write Rocky--he was meant to be Rocky Balboa. Told "no" at every turn, Sylvester Stallone bets everything on himself, holding the line on playing the lead against seemingly impossible odds. The result is the ultimate underdog story behind the ultimate underdog movie.
82739.cast: Annasophia Robb, Anthony Ippolito, Matt Dillon

82779.title: The Maltese Falcon 85th Anniversary
82779.synopsis: Academy Award winner Humphrey Bogart stars in this classic film noir as tough San Francisco private detective Sam Spade in the classic, convoluted story of Spade?s involvement with a deadly band of international thieves who will lie, double cross and murder to obtain a small, jewel-encrusted statue known as The Maltese Falcon.
82779.cast: Gladys George, Humphrey Bogart, Mary Astor

82780.title: A Beautiful Mind 25th Anniversary
82780.synopsis:
A mathematical genius, John Forbes Nash, Jr. made an astonishing discovery early in life and stood on the brink of international acclaim. But his prodigious career was sidetracked by problems that would have broken many men. Nash, however, fought back. He had always been driven by his quest for one truly original idea and never lost sight of that dream. After many years of struggle, he triumphed over tragedy and literally changed the world. The film is inspired by events in the life of John Forbes Nash, Jr., and in part based on the biography A Beautiful Mind, by Sylvia Nasar.

This special 25th anniversary release includes exclusive insight from Leonard Maltin.
82780.cast: Ed Harris, Jennifer Connelly, Russell Crowe

82788.title: It's a Wonderful Life 80th Anniversary
82788.synopsis: Embraced as a cherished holiday tradition by families around the world, Frank Capra?s heart-warming masterpiece now celebrates 75 years with this big-screen event. George Bailey (James Stewart) sets aside his dreams of world travel to run his father?s small community bank, and protect the people of Bedford Falls from greedy businessman Mr. Potter (Lionel Barrymore). When a costly mistake pushes George to the brink of despair, a visit from a kindly angel (Henry Travers) will show George how the life of one good man can change the world forever.
82788.cast: Donna Reed, James Stewart, Lionel Barrymore

82828.title: Air Bud Returns
82828.synopsis: A grieving 12-year-old boy finds his dad?s old VHS tape and befriends a golden retriever in his new year.  Together, they chase basketball dreams, rally underdogs, and discover what it means to play with heart.
82828.cast: Edwin Lee Gibson, Tracy Ifeachor, Tyler Labine

82875.title: Mr. Irrelevant
82875.synopsis: Mr. Irrelevant is the inspiring true story of John Tuggle (David Corenswet), the last player selected in the last round of the 1983 NFL draft by the New York Giants. A true underdog, Tuggle defied expectations on the field and off for his then first-year head coach, Bill Parcells (Michael Shannon), his newfound love (Isabel May), and his team, proving that remarkable hope and perseverance can transcend even the greatest challenges.

82937.title: Wild Horse Nine
82937.synopsis: In 1973 Chile, CIA agents Chris and Lee face a trust-testing journey from Santiago to Easter Island.

83023.title: JIMMY
83023.synopsis: JIMMY, the untold true story of America's most-beloved actor and the iconic role that saved him, focuses on the most transformative season in Jimmy Stewart's life--from winning the Academy Award for Best Actor in The Philadelphia Story to enlisting and becoming a combat pilot in the U.S. Army Air Corps at the beginning of World War II. Stewart flew twenty missions over Europe, rising to the rank of colonel by the end of the war, only to return home broken and disheartened. Then George Bailey and It's a Wonderful Life came calling...
83023.cast: K.J. Apa, Kara Killmer, Max Casella

83096.title: Victorian Psycho
83096.synopsis: Set in Victorian England, Victorian Psycho sees an eccentric governess arrive at a remote gothic manor, where strange happenings stir suspicion that she?s not what she seems.
83096.cast: Jason Isaacs, Maika Monroe, Thomasin McKenzie

83382.title: The Angry Birds Movie: 10th Anniversary
83382.synopsis: Celebrate the 10th anniversary of The Angry Birds Movie. A proven family hit filled with action, humor, and fan-favorite characters, this special anniversary re-release brings audiences back to Bird Island for a big-screen experience the whole family will enjoy.
83382.cast: Bill Hader, Danny McBride, Jason Sudeikis, Josh Gad

83553.title: Klara and the Sun
83553.synopsis: Based on the bestselling novel from Nobel Prize-winner Kazuo Ishiguro and written and directed by Academy-Award® winner Taika Waititi (Jojo Rabbit), KLARA AND THE SUN introduces audiences to Klara (Jenna Ortega), an Artificial Friend who wants nothing more than to find the perfect home. When Klara meets Josie (Mia Tharia), each immediately senses a kindred spirit in the other. Josie has a fraught relationship with her mother (Amy Adams) and they’ve suffered great loss, but Klara’s innocent wonder and unwavering loyalty begin to heal the family and bring light to Josie’s complicated world.
83553.cast: Amy Adams, Jenna Ortega, Mia Tharia

83683.title: November 1963
83683.synopsis: The story of the Killing of a President as told by Joseph Giancana, who was with his brother, Sam Giancana during those days. Written by their nephew and told in real time about the underbelly that pulled off this crime.
83683.cast: Dermot Mulroney, John Travolta, Robert Carlyle

83723.title: Drummer Boy
83723.synopsis: As America?s fight for independence begins, a young drummer boy, an enslaved woman, and a divided family each search for freedom in a world built to deny it. With music carrying hope through battle and loss, Drummer Boy turns the Revolution into a deeply human story of faith, forgiveness, and the belief that no person is born to live in chains or be forgotten.

83726.title: Hershey
83726.synopsis:
Based on the life of Milton Hershey, founder of the iconic Hershey chocolate company. 

Milton's grit and determination to conquer the world of candy-making propel him from bankruptcy to monumental success, and the love of his life, Kitty, helps him build a legacy sweeter than any candy bar. But when Kitty falls ill, Milton's wild optimism teeters on the edge of destruction, and she sparks an even bolder dream: to leave their fortune in the hands of America's children in need.

83930.title: MET Opera: Samson et Dalila (2026)
83930.synopsis: Sacred, scandalous, and irresistibly alluring, Saint-Saens's spectacular take on the biblical hero of legendary strength and the seductive Philistine whose beauty overpowers him returns in the Met's larger-than-life production. Featuring a massive orchestra and chorus and some of opera's most spellbinding tunes, this masterpiece of French grand opera is a feast for the eyes and ears. Giacomo Sagripanti conducts an electrifying cast led by the formidable star pairing of mezzo-soprano Aigul Akhmetshina and tenor Clay Hilley, transmitted live to cinemas worldwide.
83930.cast: Aigul Akhmetshina, Clay Hilley, Quinn Kelse

83951.title: Fing!
83951.synopsis: Librarians Mr. and Mrs. Meek indulge their demanding daughter Myrtle's every wish. When she wants a Fing, they search deep in the jungle. After finding one, Myrtle faces off against a Viscount who wants the rare creature.
83951.cast: Iona Bell, Penelope Wilton, Taika Waititi

83952.title: Above the Below
83952.synopsis: In this tense thriller, three astronauts (Idris Elba, Caitlin FitzGerald, and Hero Fiennes Tiffin) return to Earth only to discover their fight for survival has just begun. Directed by Idris Elba and Martin Owen, the film follows the crew after their damaged spacecraft is violently hurled through the atmosphere and plunges into the depths of the ocean. With oxygen rapidly running out and hope fading, they are forced to make an unthinkable choice: who will risk everything to reach the surface...and who will remain behind with the wreckage below.

83961.title: Carl Jackson's LAX: Holiday in New York
83961.synopsis: The third and final installment of the trilogy is LAX: Holiday in New York, directed by Carl Jackson. Set against the glittering, holiday-lit backdrop of New York City, the film centers on John and Kelly. The couple is in the middle of a divorce but decides to come together to spend one final Christmas holiday as a family. However, old secrets quickly resurface and hidden tensions ignite, making them realize that reuniting for the holidays may have been their most dangerous mistake yet.

84029.title: Lords of War
84029.synopsis: Nicolas Cage reprises his role as Yuri Orlov, the world's most notorious arms dealer, who discovers he has a son, a ruthless mercenary bent on surpassing his father by building a private army and exploiting America's wars in the Middle East. Thrust into a deadly battle for legacy, their fierce rivalry is fueled by power, ambition, and betrayal - with the global arms trade hanging in the balance.

84055.title: Fatherland
84055.synopsis:
FATHERLAND centres on the relationship between the Nobel Prize-winning writer Thomas Mann (Hanns Zischler) and his daughter Erika (Sandra Huller) - actress, writer and rally driver. In the summer of 1949, at the height of the Cold War, father and daughter embark on a challenging and emotional road trip in a black Buick taking them across a Germany in ruins - from US dominated Frankfurt to Soviet controlled Weimar. Returning home after sixteen years of exile in the US,
Thomas Mann has to face not only a divided fatherland, but also a deep fracture within his own family.

With FATHERLAND, Pawlikowski picks up where he left off with his award-winning Ida and ColdWar, exploring -- in his elliptic, distilled style - the themes of identity, family, love and guilt amid the turmoil and confusion of post-war Europe.
84055.cast: August Diehl, Hanns Zischler, Sandra Huller

84071.title: Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother
84071.synopsis: From writer-director Bassam Tariq, Your Mother, Your Mother, Your Mother stars Mahershala Ali as Latif, a devoutly religious hitman who struggles to balance work, faith and fatherhood. When his wife dies, he embarks on a desperate journey across Houston to protect his children, confronting the forces closing in around him - and the beliefs threatening to unravel within.

84113.title: The Mongoose
84113.synopsis: Accused of a crime he didn't commit and with nothing to lose, a war hero (Liam Neeson) leads law enforcement on a cross-country car chase with the help of his brothers in arms and a sympathetic public rooting for his getaway.
84113.cast: Liam Neeson, Marisa Tomei, Ving Rhames

84118.title: Flavia Girl Detective
84118.synopsis: Amateur detective. Master poisoner. Eleven years old. When Flavia finds a dead body at her family's decaying British manor house and her father is accused of murder, she dives into her own wild and fearless investigation, unearthing long-held family secrets and pitting herself against the true murderer. A little genius goes a long way. Based on the internationally renowned and New York Times bestselling The Flavia de Luce mystery book series.
84118.cast: Jonathan Pryce, Martin Freeman, Molly Belle Wright

84131.title: Christmas at the Kringles
84131.synopsis: Ron Livingston and Rachel Bilson star as the Seversons, a couple initially charmed by their next door neighbors the Kringles (Thomas Lennon and Arden Myrin), a Hallmark-esque family who celebrate Christmas year-round. When the Kringles turn out to be part of a sinister Christmas cult with plans to kidnap and indoctrinate them, they must rely on the help of a washed-up alcoholic Mall Santa (Rob Riggle) and their other neighbor Daryl (Donald Faison) to save the day.

84185.title: God with Us
84185.synopsis: In this modern-day parable, young couple Mary Anne Thomas (Ashley Olivia Fisher) and Joseph “Junie” Love (Aspen Kennedy) find their faith and love tested when Mary miraculously becomes pregnant.
84185.cast: Ashley Olivia Fisher, Aspen Kennedy, Rotimi

84240.title: Wicker
84240.synopsis: A fisherwoman lives on the fringes of a seaside village; she is unmarried, stinky, and constantly teased. One day, sick of her stuffy, narrow-minded neighbors, she orders a wicker husband for herself.

84278.title: MET Opera: La Fanciulla del West (2027)
84278.synopsis: Puccini's exhilarating drama of the Wild West returns in a new staging by celebrated British director Richard Jones, marking the company's first new production of La Fanciulla del West in more than 30 years. Soprano Vida Miknevici?t? makes an important Met debut as the larger-than-life Minnie, the tough tavern owner with a heart of gold who finds love when she least expects it. Tenor SeokJong Baek is the dashing bandit who rambles into the remote California mining town to steal her heart, opposite baritone Christopher Maltman as the lawman determined to deliver rough justice--and win Minnie for himself. Maestro Keri-Lynn Wilson takes the podium to conduct one of opera's most action-packed adventures, live from the Met stage to cinemas worldwide.

84284.title: MET Opera: Carmen (2026 Encore)
84284.synopsis: Bizet?s masterpiece of the seductress who lives by her own rules has had an impact far beyond the opera house. The opera?s melodic sweep is as irresistible as the title character herself, a force of nature who has become a defining female cultural figure. Carmen was a scandal at its premiere but soon after became a triumphal success and has remained one of the most frequently staged operas in the world.

84291.title: MET Opera: Magic Flute Holiday Encore (2026)
84291.synopsis: The Met made history in December 2006 when it presented its first Live in HD transmission to movie theaters worldwide ?the abridged English-language version of Mozart?s The Magic Flute. This holiday season, the opera returns to select movie theaters in a special encore presentation.

84298.title: MET Opera: Samson et Dalila Encore (2026)

84308.title: Paper Tiger
84308.synopsis: Two brothers pursue the American Dream but get entangled in a dangerous Russian mafia scheme that terrorizes their family, testing their bond as betrayal becomes possible.

84311.title: Fjord
84311.synopsis: An immigrant Romanian family living in Norway is subject to an investigation and faces the scrutiny of the local judicial system.

84326.title: Sight & Sound Presents: Joshua Live!
84326.synopsis: Journey alongside the people of Israel as they navigate their newfound freedom in an unforgiving wilderness and under a new leader, Joshua.  Captured in front of a live audience, JOSHUA LIVE! combines the energy of stage performance with the immersive experience of the cinema, bringing this unforgettable story of faith, courage and redemption to movie theaters.

84334.title: ENE Repeat
84334.synopsis: ENE REPEAT reunites a close-knit group of friends as they embark on another unforgettable journey, where old memories, new adventures, and unexpected twists test their friendship.
84334.cast: Abhinav Gomatam, Maganti Srinath, Vishwak Sen

84341.title: The Choice
84341.synopsis: THE CHOICE is a documentary about survival, grief, forgiveness, and the extraordinary human capacity to choose hope in the face of devastation.

84351.title: Coward
84351.synopsis: Set at the height of World War I in the shadows of the Belgian trenches, Lukas Dhont's COWARD unfolds as an epic, intimate journey of youthful self discovery through love, art, and survival. Pierre arrives at the front lines as a young soldier eager to find his footing in a world consumed by violence. Everything changes when he meets Francis, a kindred spirit whose vision of staging a front-line theater show unlocks a world Pierre never knew existed. What begins as a fleeting escape from the harsh reality of the trenches soon blossoms into a tender, emotional love story, anchored by the undeniable chemistry of breakout actors Emmanuel Macchia and Valentin Campagne. As the world burns around them, their stage becomes a sanctuary of innocence and devotion. COWARD beautifully explores the fine line between fear and fortitude for soldiers in search of a promised glory, ultimately asking: when the world demands brutality, is walking away for love the truest act of bravery?

84355.title: Minotaur
84355.synopsis: Intrigue, corruption, betrayal, survival: the walls of the maze are closing in. The latest from Academy Award nominated writer-director Andrey Zvyagintsev (Loveless, Leviathan), Cannes Grand Prix winner MINOTAUR is a twist-laden parable for our times. Russia, 2022. Amidst the comfortable trappings of affluence and domesticity, corporate executive Gleb (Dmitriy Mazurov) finds himself under siege on all fronts. At home, he is haunted by suspicions that his increasingly distant wife Galina (Iris Lebedeva) is unfaithful. At work, he contends with a demand from local authorities to draft a quota of employees for the war in Ukraine. Desperate to keep his hands clean, Gleb struggles to reassert control even as the collapse of his carefully ordered life seems fated to accelerate toward violence. A pressure cooker in cinematic form, MINOTAUR uncovers and indicts the heart of societal darkness with searing clarity. Uniting intimately-drawn performances and stark visual power, this is peerless work from an indisputable master.

84366.title: La Bola Negra
84366.synopsis: LA BOLA NEGRA is a bold, passionate triptych spanning nearly a century of Spanish history from the 30s to modern day. The film tells the story of three men whose lives are intimately connected through desire, pain, and inheritance.

84370.title: The Only Living Pickpocket In New York
84370.synopsis: Harry Lehman (John Turturro) is an aging pickpocket who plies his trade with ever-diminishing returns in a drastically changed New York. Wallets stuffed with cash have been replaced by easily canceled credit cards, and Harry struggles to make ends meet as he cares for his disabled wife, Rosie. When he unwittingly purloins and fences a valuable USB stick, Harry finds himself in a race against time to return the loot or face the rage of a vengeful crime family.
84370.cast: Giancarlo Esposito, John Turturro, Will Price

84380.title: Danemark et les Iles Feroe - Les aventuriers voyageurs
84380.synopsis: In this documentary, at once a journey of discovery, an intimate exploration, and a reflection on quality of life, Tommy and his travel companion  Janie Lapointe  explore this realm shaped by water, wind, and a profoundly human philosophy of living. Here, urbanism meets nature, design meets tradition, and happiness is cultivated day after day.

84430.title: Festive Fun with Peppa Cinema Experience
84430.synopsis: Join Peppa Pig and her family at the cinema for a festive big-screen experience as they celebrate Evie's first Christmas! Share in the excitement of the holidays as the family of five reflect on treasured festive memories. From snowy adventures and holiday plays to decorating the tree, this hour-long cinema experience brings together 7 classic festive-themed Peppa Pig episodes and 4 brand-new songs that little ones can dance and sing along to. Filled with laughter, music and heartwarming moments, this special cinema experience is the perfect family day out during the holiday season. So grab your hats, scarves and gloves and enjoy the holiday magic along with your favorite piggies at the Festive Fun with Peppa Cinema Experience!

84437.title: BTS WORLD TOUR 'ARIRANG' IN SAO PAULO: LIVE VIEWING
84437.synopsis: Experience the BTS WORLD TOUR 'ARIRANG' in cinemas worldwide, broadcasting from São Paulo, Brazil! Marking the grand finale of their Latin America tour, this monumental concert will bring the explosive energy of the packed stadium in Brazil straight to the big screen. Please note that broadcasts in some territories are scheduled later to accommodate local time zones.

84449.title: The Debut
84449.synopsis: When Mona Friedman is cast in a bit part at a small community theater, she transforms from a shy, unassuming housewife into a zealous method actor willing to do anything to protect the artistic integrity of her marginal role--even if it means waging war against the show's domineering director.
84449.cast: Halle Bailey, Julianne Moore, Paul Giamatti

84452.title: The One
84452.synopsis: When 18-year-old Hawk ages out of the Chicago foster system, he sets out to see the lighting of the country's largest Christmas tree, the One. Carrying only his guitar and a few belongings, he faces homelessness and a harsh winter alone until he crosses paths with Jefferson, a mysterious traveler, and Alexis, a runaway teenager grieving the loss of her twin sister. Together, they embark on an unexpected journey of faith, hope, and healing.
84452.cast: Jana Kramer, Martin Sheen, Nick Zano

84456.title: Japon - lumiere d'automne - Les aventuriers voyageurs
84456.synopsis: Immerse yourself in the heart of a fascinating country where ancient traditions and modernity coexist in perfect harmony. From bustling metropolises like Tokyo to serene places like Kyoto, this journey unveils the many facets of the Japanese archipelago. Through encounters and discoveries, the film leads us to iconic sites steeped in history and emotion, such as Hiroshima and the sacred island of Miyajima, as well as to more peaceful regions, including the majestic landscapes of the Japanese Alps. Between ancient temples, ultramodern cities, and breathtaking panoramas bathed in the colors of autumn, our adventurers Serge and Johanne offer a sensitive and authentic perspective on Japan.

84492.title: A Talent for Murder
84492.synopsis: A mysterious young man from a New York publisher is sent to Switzerland to persuade the renowned writer Patricia Highsmith to write one final installment of the Ripley anthology.
84492.cast: Alden Ehrenreich, Helen Mirren, Olivia Cooke

84493.title: Club Kid
84493.synopsis: An organizer of underground parties is forced to take care of a son whose existence he was completely unaware of.
84493.cast: Cara Delevingne, Diego Calva, Miss Benny

84501.title: Tender Loving Care
84501.synopsis: Palme d'Or winner and Academy Award nominee Mike Leigh returns with his next feature film, continuing his insightful exploration of the contemporary world. With his distinctive cinematic voice, he once again delves into themes that challenge and resonate with modern audiences.
84501.cast: Kate O'Flynn, Marion Bailey, Paul Jesson

84503.title: The Liberation
84503.synopsis: Rita (Coon), a woman in midlife haunted by the weight of her past, encounters magnetic young spiritual leader Ricki (James) and leaves her family to follow her to an all-female commune. But when her daughters Ella (Ramsey) and Jo (Young) arrive unexpectedly and become drawn into the group's seductive world, Rita is forced to choose between the family she left behind and the life she believes can save her.
84503.cast: Bella Ramsey, Carrie Coon, Lily James

84505.title: Behemoth!
84505.synopsis: A gifted cellist, Alex Serian (Pedro Pascal), returns home to Los Angeles after 20 years on the road.  Music, which has been the constant, all-consuming river of his life, begins to carry Alex on an adventure that will change him forever.
84505.cast: Eva Victor, Olivia Wilde, Pedro Pascal

84512.title: All of a Sudden
84512.synopsis: Two scholars exchange letters about chance and risk. As the philosopher falls ill, their academic correspondence evolves into intimate discussions about mortality and a deeper connection forms between them.

84514.title: Clarissa
84514.synopsis: Based on Mrs. Dalloway. Follows a Lagos society wife preparing for a party while reflecting on her youth and the choices that led her to marry a respected man instead of her poet boyfriend.
84514.cast: Ayo Edebiri, David Oyelowo, Sophie Okonedo

84564.title: Bitter Christmas
84564.synopsis: BITTER CHRISTMAS tells two alternating stories, one starring Elsa, an advertising director, in 2004, during a long weekend in December. The second takes place in 2026 and stars Raul, a screenwriter and director who is writing a script that we soon discover is the story of Elsa, her boyfriend Bonifacio, and her friends Patricia and Natalia. Mixed with fiction, Elsa is, in a way, Raul's alter ego, who, like him, resorts to autofiction as a solution to a long period of creative drought. He looks inside himself, and he can't help but also look at the people who make up his most intimate universe: his partner and his assistant.
84564.cast: Aitana Sanchez-Gijon, Barbara Lennie, Leonardo Sbaraglia, Victoria Luengo

84567.title: INDE les Mysteres du Gange - Les aventuriers voyageurs
84567.synopsis: After captivating audiences with their Italian saga, Michele and Martin radically change scenery to immerse themselves in the intensity of Northern India. From the vibrant energy of Delhi to the sacred banks of the Ganges, and on to the breathtaking panoramas of the Himalayas, they reveal an India that is both vibrant and profoundly human. Amidst flamboyant colors, age-old traditions, and the seething energy of the streets, the journey also offers moments of tranquility and pure emotion. Enchanting ceremonies, unforgettable encounters, majestic temples, and authentic scenes of daily life: this new film invites you to see, feel, and experience India? in a new way.

84571.title: Raise the Red Lantern (1991) (re)
84571.synopsis: Teenage Songlian (Gong Li), whose family has been devastated by the recent death of her father, becomes the third concubine of wealthy Master Chen. She soon discovers that behind the palatial luxury of life in the master's house, she and her fellow concubines are pitted against each other in a struggle for his affections. The situation inevitably leads to deception, jealous rages, and the revelation of each other's darkest secrets.

84602.title: George Michael: The Faith Tour
84602.synopsis: An electric concert film featuring recently rediscovered, never-before-seen footage of the global superstar at the Palais Omnisports de Paris-Bercy during the European leg of the Faith Tour in 1988. A triumph in archival filmmaking, George Michael: The Faith Tour transforms footage assembled from a 14-camera shoot captured on 35mm film over two nights, into an extraordinary cinematic event and audio experience.

84605.title: Primetime
84605.synopsis:
In 2006, To Catch a Predator host Chris Hansen sets out to make 
television history.
84605.cast: Merritt Wever, Robert Pattinson, Skyler Gisondo

84619.title: Dead of Night
84619.synopsis: Guests under 17 must be accompanied by a guardian who is 21 or older. Please be prepared to show ID at the theatre. When a small town is terrorized by a series of brutal murders, the sheriff, his daughter, and a desperate mayor race to uncover the truth.
84619.cast: Dermot Mulroney, Kirrilee Berger, Scott Grimes

84620.title: Everest: The Other Side
84620.synopsis: Elite ski mountaineers Jim Morrison and Hilaree Nelson share an audacious dream: to climb up and ski down the direct North Face of Everest, taking on one of the most dangerous routes on the world’s tallest mountain. Blending breathtaking spectacle and romance, this is an epic story of resilience and transcendence.

84621.title: Hurricanna
84621.synopsis: In the hours surrounding a glamorous appearance at a championship boxing match, supermodel Anna Nicole Smith, her psychiatrist, and her lover form a disastrous trio and descend towards chaos.
84621.cast: Holly Hunter, Mark Duplass, Sylvia Hoeks

84697.title: Donga Naa Koduku
84697.synopsis: A robbery crime comedy centered around a jewellery shop heist that goes hilariously wrong.

84718.title: King
84718.synopsis: Mentor and disciple embark on a perilous journey, pushing their survival skills to the limit against overwhelming odds and unforgiving environments.

84722.title: Avengers: Doomsday RealD 3D Fan Event
84722.synopsis: Join us on December 20 for a special RealD 3D Fan Event screening of Marvel Studios' Avengers: Doomsday. Every guest receives a pair of collectible 3D glasses featuring one of five mystery logos. Which universe will you represent: The Avengers, Black Panther, X-Men, Fantastic Four, or the elusive Dr. Doom. Which pair will you get?

84724.title: Ozzy & Black Sabbath: Back To The Beginning
84724.synopsis:
OZZY & BLACK SABBATH: BACK TO THE BEGINNING documents a landmark moment in music history: Ozzy Osbourne's historic final farewell performance for his fans at Villa Park stadium in his Birmingham hometown--captured just 17 days before his untimely passing. The film highlights the historic day with performances from Ozzy, Black Sabbath, and some of the most influential names in rock, along with personal reflections from the superstar musicians they inspired and a behind-the-scenes look at the day itself.

This is an historic and intimate farewell to Ozzy and the band that changed music forever.

84732.title: Stray Kids World Tour 'RUN IT' LIVE VIEWING
84732.synopsis:
For the first time, Stray Kids presents a special live broadcast of STRAY KIDS WORLD TOUR 'RUN IT' LIVE VIEWING from Tokyo Dome in movie theaters around the globe.
 
True to the tour's title, 'RUN IT' captures the group's drive to push into bigger worlds and bolder stages. The eight members (Bang Chan, Lee Know, Changbin, Hyunjin, HAN, Felix, Seungmin, and I.N) pour out unrelenting energy through explosive choreography and powerhouse vocals, elevating the live experience to its peak. Their stage begins with "Hall of Fame," a track that expresses Stray Kids' ambition to write their own history, tracing their musical growth from the very beginning to where they are now. The production is enriched further by dynamic stage setups, traditional Korean performance touches, and spectacular laser lighting, designed to bring the crowd -- in the dome and at the cinema -- to their feet, singing, dancing and celebrating together.
 
Captured live from Tokyo and broadcast into cinemas worldwide, this live viewing event lets STAY everywhere share in the scale, spectacle, and raw energy of Stray Kids' live performance -- together, on the big screen.
84732.advisory: AMC has been advised that this film contains sequences with flashing lights that may affect photosensitive viewers.

84741.title: Ink
84741.synopsis: The film is based on the Tony-nominated play by multi-Olivier award-winning playwright and screenwriter James Graham. The film is an explosive cinematic rollercoaster about a group of visionaries and misfits who had an idea for a new kind of news -- one that would give the people what they want and would change the face of the world we live in today.
84741.cast: Claire Foy, Guy Pearce, Jack O'Connell

84750.title: Ken Russell's The Devils
84750.synopsis: Oliver Reed plays a French priest ( Urbain Grandier) in the 17th century. He is at odds with the church due to his radical political and religious opinions. When he appears to have influenced a group of nuns with his beliefs, he is arrested and tortured.

84768.title: Dune: Part Three Insider Screenings
84768.synopsis: THE JOURNEY TO ARRAKIS BEGINS. This early showing is intended for Dune Insiders—fans who have opted into the film’s official Insider program for a direct connection to the campaign, including updates, special content and more.

84773.title: GIANT - The Play
84773.synopsis:
GIANT, the 5-star critically acclaimed play starring John Lithgow (Killers of the Flower Moon, The Crown) as Roald Dahl, comes to the big screen. Winner of 3 Olivier Awards? including Best Play and a Tony Award? for Best Actor in a Play (John Lithgow), the production was filmed live in London's West End ahead of its sold-out Broadway run. The stellar cast includes Aya Cash (The Boys, The Franchise, You're the Worst), Elliot Levey (Cold War, Patriots, Good) and Rachael Stirling (The Divine Mrs S).
 
A world-famous children's author under threat. A battle of wills in the wake of scandal. And one chance to make amends...It's the summer of 1983, The Witches is about to hit the shelves and Roald Dahl is making last-minute edits.  But the outcry at his recent, explicitly antisemitic article won't die down. Across a single afternoon at his family home, and rocked by an unexpectedly explosive confrontation, Dahl is forced to choose: make a public apology or risk his name and reputation. Inspired by real events, GIANT explores with dark humour the difference between considered opinion and dangerous rhetoric offering a complicated portrait of a fiendishly charismatic icon.

84786.title: Gradiva, La
84786.synopsis: A class of high school students travels to Pompeii to discover ruins and bodies petrified by Vesuvius. The trip becomes a rare moment when the force of youth meets a world frozen in time. Their desires start to surface with unexpected intensity, leading them toward an irreversible fracture.

84831.title: The Crow - Welcome to Horrorwood Series
84831.synopsis: The night before his wedding, musician Eric Draven and his fiancée are brutally murdered by members of a violent gang. On the anniversary of their death, Eric rises from the grave and assumes the mantle of the Crow, a supernatural avenger.

84847.title: V For Vendetta 20th Anniversary
84847.synopsis: Set against the futuristic landscape of totalitarian Britain, V FOR VENDETTA tells the story of a mild-mannered young woman named Evey (NATALIE PORTMAN) who is rescued from a life-and-death situation by a masked man (HUGO WEAVING) known only as 'V.' Incomparably charismatic and ferociously skilled in the art of combat and deception, V ignites a revolution when he urges his fellow citizens to rise up against tyranny and oppression. As Evey uncovers the truth about V's mysterious background, she also discovers the truth about herself - and emerges as his unlikely ally in the culmination of his plan to bring freedom and justice back to a society fraught with cruelty and corruption.
84847.cast: Hugo Weaving, Natalie Portman, Stephen Rea

84861.title: NT Live: Golden Boy
84861.cast: Daniel Mays, Hayley Squires, Josh O'Connor

84866.title: Itllu Arjuna
84866.synopsis: Follows a mute man with exceptional skills who falls in love, proving that true feelings do not always need words.

84880.title: Josephine
84880.synopsis: After 8-year-old Josephine accidentally witnesses a crime in Golden Gate Park, she acts out in search of a way to regain control of her safety, while adults are helpless to console her.
84880.cast: Channing Tatum, Gemma Chan, Mason Reeves, Philip Ettinger

84893.title: The Nightmare Before Christmas (RE26)
84893.synopsis: Jack Skellington, king of Halloween Town, discovers Christmas Town, but his attempts to bring Christmas to his home causes confusion.

84943.title: Mouse
84943.synopsis: When an introverted high-schooler in small-town Arkansas loses her best friend to a car accident, she forms an unexpected bond with her friend's mother while navigating the fraught, fragile, and often funny stages of grief.
84943.cast: Chloe Coleman, Katherine Mallen Kupferer, Sophie Okonedo

84970.title: The Mosquito Bowl
84970.synopsis: Following the attack on Pearl Harbor, four of America's top college football stars set their fame aside to enlist in the Marines. As they prepare for the brutal invasion of Okinawa, they'll play in a legendary game featuring some of the greatest players in history -- a game that, for many, will be the last they ever play.
84970.cast: Bill Skarsgard, Nicholas Galitzine, Ray Nicholson

84989.title: Everybody Digs Bill Evans
84989.synopsis: June 1961, New York. Legendary jazz pianist Bill Evans has found his musical voice and created the perfect trio, including bass player Scott LaFaro, his musical soulmate. A residency at New York's Village Vanguard culminates in the live taping of two of the greatest jazz records of all time in one day. Days later, LaFaro dies tragically in a car crash. Numb with grief, Evans stops playing for the first time since childhood. This is the story of what happened next for one of the most influential and gifted figures in 20th Century music. Grant Gee won Best Director at the 2026 Berlin International Film Festival.
84989.cast: Anders Danielsen Lie, Bill Pullman, Laurie Metcalf

84991.title: Ramayana
84991.synopsis:
Hindi with English Subtitles. Based on the celebrated ancient epic known to billions, Namit Malhotra's Ramayana: Rise of a Legend tells the story of Rama, a prince bound by sacrifice; Ravana, an immortal king driven by vengeance; and the prophecy that binds their fates together. It stars Ranbir Kapoor, Yash and Sai Pallavi. 

The film is produced by acclaimed filmmaker Namit Malhotra, whose Academy Award®-winning visual effects company DNEG has worked on films including The Odyssey, Dune, Interstellar, and Inception; directed by Nitesh Tiwari, whose film Dangal remains the highest-grossing Indian film worldwide; and scored by Academy Award® winners Hans Zimmer and A.R. Rahman. Namit Malhotra's Ramayana: Rise of a Legend will be released globally in theaters in time for Diwali on November 5.

84993.title: Hell House LLC 10th Anniversary
84993.synopsis: Five years after an unexplained malfunction causes the death of 15 tour-goers and staff on the opening night of a Halloween haunted house tour, a documentary crew travels back to the scene of the tragedy to find out what really happened.
84993.cast: Alice Bahlke, Danny Bellini, Gore Abrams

84997.title: Rose
84997.synopsis: In the turmoil of the Thirty-Years' War, a mysterious soldier appears in a secluded Protestant village claiming to be heir to a long-abandoned manor. His quest for recognition and acceptance are complicated by his secret: under a false identity, false name, and pretense of a false gender, he has made his way to the village. But to achieve her goals, Rose, as the soldier is actually called, will stop at nothing.

85010.title: Rocky 50th Anniversary
85010.synopsis:
Struggling Philadelphia boxer Rocky Balboa has a chance to become a somebody when heavyweight champion Apollo Creed come up with the Bicentennial gimmick of fighting a sure-ringer and easily winning the bout himself. But someone forgot to tell Rocky, who trains earnestly. And in the climactic fight sequence, the "Italian Stallion" gets his wish: to go the distance...against all the odds!

Rocky 50 will also feature an exclusive look at the widely-anticipated biographical feature film, I Play Rocky, a Baha Fireside Production from Amazon MGM Studios and directed by Academy Award®- winning director Peter Farrelly (Green Book, There’s Something About Mary), alongside an introduction from the I Play Rocky cast.
85010.cast: Burt Young, Sylvester Stallone, Talia Shire

85018.title: Artificial
85018.cast: Andrew Garfield, Monica Barbaro, Yura Borisov

85044.title: Orfeo
85044.synopsis: In the classic Greek tragedy, a snake bites Eurydice on her wedding day, and her new husband, Orpheus, travels to the Underworld to bring her back. Virgilio Villoresi's expressionistic adaptation of the tale is based on Dino Buzzati's 1969 Poema a fumetti, Italy's first graphic novel. The film is a modern reimagining with an aesthetic untethered from reality: a kaleidoscopic journey through time and place, reflecting on art, love, mystery, eroticism, melancholy, life, and death.
85044.cast: Aomi Muyock, Giulia Maenza, Luca Vergoni

85058.title: In the Mouth
85058.synopsis: A perpetual worrywart finds himself unable to leave his house after discovering a giant version of himself protruding from his front lawn.
85058.cast: Colin Burgess, Paul Rothery, Sage Francis

85066.title: Breeder
85066.synopsis: An eccentric poodle breeder lures a broke college student to her remote ranch with a promise of research funding. But, as he soon learns, there's a catch.
85066.cast: Daniel Doheny, Dot-Marie Jones, Maddie Philips

85072.title: Elf
85072.synopsis: A human baby raised as an elf. A city where no one remembers the true meaning of Christmas. Will Ferrell (Saturday Night Live, Superstar) stars as Buddy, a human raised in the North Pole to be an elf. After wreaking havoc in the elf community due to his size, Buddy heads to New York City to find his place in the world, and track down his father. But life in the big city is not all sugarplums and candy canes. His father is a 'Scrooge' and his eight-year-old stepbrother doesn't believe in Santa. Even the snowmen aren't friendly in New York. In fact, they don't even speak. Worst of all, everyone has forgotten the true meaning of Christmas, and it's up to Buddy and his simple elf ways to win over his family, realize his destiny and, ultimately, save Christmas for New York and the world. Directed by John Favreau (Swingers), Elf is a warm-hearted Christmas comedy written by David Berenbaum.

85073.title: The Polar Express
85073.synopsis: On Christmas Eve, a young boy embarks on a magical adventure to the North Pole on the Polar Express, while learning about friendship, bravery, and the spirit of Christmas.

85074.title: Dr. Seuss' How The Grinch Stole Christmas
85074.synopsis: The curmudgeonly recluse Grinch, who hates Christmas, becomes annoyed with the out-of-control Christmas festivities in Whoville, the town lying below his cave dwelling on Mt. Crumpit. But after the Grinch conspires to deprive the Who's of their favorite holiday by sneaking into town on Christmas eve to steal everything associated with the holiday, he learns that the spirit of Christmas goes much deeper than tinsel and toys.

85075.title: Love Actually (HFS26)
85075.synopsis: Follows the lives of eight very different couples in dealing with their love lives in various loosely interrelated tales all set during a frantic month before Christmas in London, England.

85076.title: Bad Santa
85076.synopsis: Two con men masquerade as Santa Claus and an elf, knocking off shopping malls. But then they meet an 8-year-old boy, who unintentionally reminds them about the true meaning of Christmas.

85077.title: Gremlins
85077.synopsis: With its Christmas lights and dusting of snow, Kingston Falls is an idyllic small town--until the gremlins take over. A father returns from Chinatown with an unusual pet, a Mogwai--a gift for his son. The rules are simple: Keep your Mogwai away from water, bright lights and, most importantly, never--never--feed him after midnight. But the rules are inadvertently broken, and the consequences multiply at an alarming rate.

85078.title: Scrooged
85078.synopsis: High-spirited high jinks on Christmas Eve put Frank Cross (Bill Murray) in a ghostly time warp in this hilarious take-off of Charles Dickens' A Christmas Carol. Cross, who has made the meteoric rise from the depths of the mail room to TV network president, is mean, nasty, uncaring, unforgiving and has a sadistic sense of humor - perfect qualities for a modern-day Scrooge. Before the night is over, he'll be visited by a maniacal New York cab driver from the past, a present-day fairy who’s into pratfalls and, finally, a ghoulish, seven-foot headless messenger from the future.

85086.title: Secret Lives of Baba Segi's Wives
85086.synopsis: A rich patriarch's delicate family falls apart when his youngest of four wives cannot have a child.
85086.cast: Bimbo Ademoye, Mercy Aigbe, Odunlade Adekola

85107.title: Andre Rieu's 2026 Christmas Concert: Let it Snow!
85107.synopsis: Known to millions as `The King of Waltz?, Andre Rieu is the world?s leading pop classical artist and consistently appears on the worldwide list of highest-grossing touring artists.

85115.title: Paging Hezbollah
85115.synopsis: PAGING HEZBOLLAH reveals how Israel pulled off one of the most audacious intelligence operations in history - engineering, marketing, and smuggling a modern-day Trojan Horse into Hezbollah's command network before destroying it with a single beep. Told by those who lived and planned it, this is the little-known story of ingenuity, deception and an operation decades in the making.

85123.title: Rehearsals for a Revolution
85123.synopsis: Through five portraits of her loved ones, each a figure of resistance, Pegah Ahangarani traces the intimate story of her life. Drawing on her personal archives, family videos, images of demonstrations, press articles, and sound recordings, she traverses more than forty years of Iranian history. From the first stirrings of 1979 to the war that erupted in 2026, she weaves a dialogue between individual memory and collective history, painting a portrait of a country marked by political repression but relentlessly driven by the desire for freedom and the hope of revolution.

85133.title: Soul Patrol
85133.synopsis: Soul Patrol uncovers a hidden chapter of American military history by focusing on the Vietnam War's first Black special ops team, an elite unit operating deep behind enemy lines. With unprecedented access to this once-secretive group of African-American veterans, director J.M. Harper reconstructs their journey with an immediacy rarely seen in Vietnam War storytelling, using raw Super 8 footage, photographs, and audio recordings from their personal archives. Opening on the war?s 50th anniversary, the surviving members reunite in a hotel that becomes a surreal liminal space, where memory, brotherhood, and unresolved trauma collide. As the men reflect on their experiences, the film interrogates the contradictions of fighting for freedom abroad while facing inequality at home. Winner of the Directing Award for U.S. Documentary at the Sundance Film Festival, Soul Patrol is not just a war story, but a reckoning ? an intimate portrait of survival, memory, and the enduring cost of war on those asked to fight it.

85134.title: The Friend's House is Here
85134.synopsis: In Tehran's underground art scene, Pari, a theater director, and Hanna, a dancer, are roommates, best friends, actors, and professional partners, navigating rehearsals, performances, and the quiet rituals of everyday life--until their secret circle is discovered. Shot covertly but far removed from familiar portrayals of Iran, directors Maryam Ataei and Hossein Keshavarz blur the boundaries between theatrical performance and lived experience, crafting a luminous portrait of sisterhood where art becomes inseparable from life and even the smallest creative choices can become acts of resistance. Winner of the US Dramatic Special Jury Award for Ensemble Cast at the 2026 Sundance Film Festival.

85135.title: Villeneuve: L'ascension d'une legende
85135.cast: Joe Cobden, Luc Picard, Neil Webb

85142.title: You Can See Everything
85142.synopsis: Thirty-four days before she's sent to prison, notorious Silicon Valley founder Elizabeth Holmes invites a skeptical film crew to document her every move. What begins as an intimate portrait of an enigmatic felon becomes a mind-bending three-year journey into the abyss. From boundary-pushing directors Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim comes YOU CAN SEE EVERYTHING.

85174.title: Godzilla Minus Zero: Sensory Friendly Screening
85174.synopsis:
War reduced Japan to zero, and Godzilla plunged it into minus. Two years have passed since then, and the country has faced agonizing struggles to achieve recovery and finally reclaim its daily life.

Just as humanity managed to cling to a hard-won peace, a new threat strikes, crushing hope in an instant.

85175.title: The Cat in the Hat: Sensory Friendly Screening
85175.synopsis: Meet the Cat in the Hat you don't know! In the wonderfully whimsical tradition of Dr. Seuss, THE CAT IN THE HAT, voiced by Bill Hader, comes to the big screen in his animated theatrical feature film debut, an all-new, epic adventure where mischief, magic and mayhem reign supreme.

85185.title: Wild at Heart - Unrated
85185.synopsis:
Guests under 17 must be accompanied by a guardian who is 21 or older. Please be prepared to show ID at the theatre. 
Young lovers Sailor and Lula run from the variety of weirdos that Lula's mom has hired to kill Sailor.

85190.title: Dive in Wonderland
85190.synopsis: Feature length anime inspired by Lewis Carroll's timeless novels. In-crisis university student Rise (Nanoka Hara) tumbles into Wonderland and meets Alice (Maika Pugh) The two have curious adventures in a whimsical, nonsensical world.

85192.title: The Irregular at Magic High School The Movie -Yotsuba Succession Arc-
85192.synopsis: It is  2096, about a century after magic was established as a real technology. Tatsuya Shiba, born into the prestigious Yotsuba family of magicians but with a fatal flaw as a magician, and his perfect younger sister Miyuki, who possesses extraordinary talent as a magician, are about to enter the winter of their second year of high school. The siblings, who are complete opposites as an underachiever and an overachiever, spend their days together in harmony until one day a letter arrives. It is an invitation to the "Keishunkai" to be held at the main Yotsuba house on New Year's Day. At this gathering, where the head of the Yotsuba family, Maya, and the heads of the branch families will come together, the next head of the Yotsuba family will be nominated, but a shocking truth will be revealed there.
85192.cast: Chiwa Saito, Saori Hayami, Yuichi Nakamura

85197.title: TOMORROW X TOGETHER WORLD TOUR 'ACT : TOMORROW'
85197.synopsis:
In October 2026, an exhilarating moment arrives as HYBE artists and global fans connect as one through the screen. HYBE CINE FEST 2026 expands from Latin America and Asia to screens worldwide.

85201.title: Jump Scare
85201.synopsis: The female metal band Jump Scare retreat to a remote cabin to write their next album, only to be terrorized by the family of cannibals next door

85213.title: Search Party: Where's PawPaw?
85213.synopsis: Noble Kristian Silk Williams rushes home after Aunt Meek Meek (Tichina Arnold) warns that PawPaw's (Tommy Davidson) health has taken a turn for the worse. After visiting him in a rundown nursing home, Noble and her quirky best friends return to find him missing. Joined by their chaotic, self-reformed hood-Aunty, they follow bizarre clues and encounter eccentric characters in a race to find PawPaw before time runs out.
85213.cast: Tichina Arnold, Tommy Davidson, Victoria Monai Richards

85215.title: Paradise Lost
85215.synopsis: From acclaimed master of Korean thriller cinema Yeon Sang-ho comes a gripping psychological mystery. Nine years after her son vanished in a tragic bus kidnapping, grieving mother So-young copes using alternate reality technology. When her missing son suddenly returns as a cold adult stranger, her world fractures between the real, distant man and the virtual child who needs her. So-young is forced into a devastating choice between truth and illusion.

85219.title: Godzilla Minus Zero - Godzilla Day IMAX Early Access
85219.synopsis:
War reduced Japan to zero, and Godzilla plunged it into minus. Two years have passed since then, and the country has faced agonizing struggles to achieve recovery and finally reclaim its daily life.

85227.title: Doctor Who: The Satan Pit
85227.synopsis:
Celebrate Doctor Who Day with an exclusive big-screen event marking 20 years of the Tenth Doctor and Rose Tyler.

For the first time ever in cinemas, the acclaimed two-part adventure The Impossible Planet and The Satan Pit have been specially re-edited into a single movie-length presentation, created exclusively for theatrical audiences. Join the Doctor (David Tennant) and Rose (Billie Piper) as they travel to Sanctuary Base 6, a remote outpost perched on a planet orbiting a black hole. When an ancient force awakens beneath the surface, the crew find themselves trapped in a battle against an evil older than time itself.

This special Doctor Who Day screening also includes exclusive bonus material, featuring previously unseen content and a brand-new interview with a special guest, reflecting on the making of one of the most celebrated stories of the modern era -- from encounters with the Ood to facing the terrifying Beast, alongside behind-the-scenes memories from the set.
85227.cast: Billie Piper, Danny Webb, David Tennant

85233.title: AMC Screen Unseen: November 2
85233.synopsis: AMC Screen Unseen, where guests can watch a never-before-seen film. We will share the movie’s MPA rating ahead of time, but the feature presentation will remain a mystery until showtime. Share your reaction after the movie with #AMCScreenUnseen on Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, Threads and X.

85244.title: Being Heumann
85244.synopsis: They wouldn't take Judy Heumann's phone calls, so she took their building. In 1977, a young disabled woman (Ruth Madeley) and a scrappy coalition of outsiders decide they've had enough. What begins as one impulsive act becomes the longest occupation of a federal building in American history, as hundreds spontaneously seize government offices and refuse to leave until the bureaucrat in their way (Mark Ruffalo) takes action. Bringing rebellion in all its forms to the hallowed halls, a movement's accidental leaders struggle to find their path forward where none has ever been paved for them. Directed by Academy Award winner Sian Heder (CODA) and based on true events, BEING HEUMANN is the revolutionary, irreverent and deeply human story of the least likely people trying to pull off the impossible and change the lives of millions.
85244.cast: Madeline Delp, Mark Ruffalo, Ruth Madeley

85251.title: Dada
85251.synopsis: A stylish and uncompromising underworld don aggressively conquers the lawless Mumbai streets, weaponizing his fierce trademark justice to systematically dismantle a lethal corporate criminal syndicate.

85252.title: Summer Holidays
85252.synopsis: A city boy's summer at his grandparents' Godavari village transforms when he befriends a spirited local paper boy. Together they explore rural life through adventures that forge an unforgettable childhood bond

85274.title: January 12 Vidudala
85274.synopsis:
Two Army officers and best friends, Venkat Reddy and Bal Reddy are very efficient in handling crises situation regarding national defense. when Bal Reddy returns to his native village, he encounters unexpected rift in within a family divided by tradition, identity, and pride. Venkat reddy steps in to heal the growing rift, but faces unimaginable difficulties in process.
This setup against the vibrant backdrop of Rayalaseema, the story blends action, romance, humor, and family drama sacrifice, and the enduring power of love, friendship,
85274.cast: Keerthy Suresh, Nandamuri Kalyan Ram, Venkatesh Daggubati

85276.title: UFC 334: Gane vs. Hokit
85276.synopsis:
Two undisputed championships. Four elite fighters. One massive night. Heavyweight champion Ciryl Gane puts his title on the line against undefeated American powerhouse Josh Hokit, whose rapid rise has taken him all the way to a shot at UFC gold.

Plus, one of the most anticipated fights in women's MMA history finally becomes a reality. Bantamweight champion Kayla Harrison defends her crown against the returning Amanda Nunes, as the former two-division champion and one of the most decorated fighters in UFC history steps back into the Octagon looking to reclaim her throne.

85304.title: Yeh Prem Mol Liya
85304.synopsis: A small-town boy chasing big dreams in Mumbai turns tradition on its head when he moves into his wife's home along with his entire family - forcing two clashing households to learn what true love, respect actually is. YEH PREM MOL LIYA is set to release in theatres worldwide on November 27th, 2026.

85305.title: The Host (2007) (re)
85305.synopsis: Gang-du (SONG Kang-ho) works at a food-stand on the banks of the Han River. Dozing on the job, he is awakened by his daughter, Hyun-seo ( KO A-sung), who is angry with him for missing a teacher-parent meeting at school. As Gang-du walks out to the riverbank with a delivery, he notices that a large crowd of people has gathered, taking pictures and talking about something hanging from the Han River Bridge. The otherwise idyllic landscape turns suddenly to bedlam when a terrifying creature climbs up onto the riverbank and begins to crush and eat people. Gang-du and his daughter run for their lives but suddenly the thing grabs Hyun-seo and disappears back into the river. The government announces that the thing apparently is the Host of an unidentified virus. Having feared the worst, Gang-du receives a phone call from his daughter who is frightened, but very much alive. Gang-du makes plans to infiltrate the forbidden zone near the Han River to rescue his daughter from the clutches of the horrifying Host...

85310.title: Best Pancakes in the County
85310.synopsis: A cunning criminal returns to his remote diner after a botched FBI heist, where rival assassins, corrupt agents, and an underestimated waitress collide in a deadly confrontation.
85310.cast: Justin Long, Lauren German, Nicolas Cage

85318.title: The Gallerist
85318.synopsis: A gallerist, driven by a desperate desire for success, hatches a scheme to cover up a dead man as an extraordinary art piece at a pretentious Miami art fair.
85318.cast: Jenna Ortega, Natalie Portman, Sterling K. Brown

85319.title: Look Back
85319.synopsis:
Confident grade-schooler Fujino draws comics for her school newspaper, earning the admiration of her classmates. When her artwork is surpassed by her reclusive peer Kyomoto, she becomes obsessed with honing her skills, eventually burning out and giving up drawing altogether. But when Fujino finally meets Kyomoto, she discovers that Kyomoto has been her devoted fan all along. Bound by their shared passion, they spend irreplaceable years drawing manga together until a fateful event changes their lives forever.

From Palme d'Or winner Hirokazu Koreeda, Look Back is a love letter to the artistic process, hand-written in ink on paper, and a meditation on how mutual pursuit of a craft creates the deepest etches in our memory.

85337.title: Gotta Have Faith: George Michael IMAX Early Access
85337.synopsis: An electric concert film featuring recently rediscovered, never-before-seen footage of the global superstar at the Palais Omnisports de Paris-Bercy during the European leg of the Faith Tour in 1988. A triumph in archival filmmaking, George Michael: The Faith Tour transforms footage assembled from a 14-camera shoot captured on 35mm film over two nights, into an extraordinary cinematic event and audio experience. On Wednesday, December 9 fans can be among the first to see the film by attending the Gotta Have Faith: George Michael IMAX Early Access Event Screenings and receive a Collectible Ticket.

85345.title: AMC Screen Unseen: November 9
85345.synopsis: AMC Screen Unseen, where guests can watch a never-before-seen film. We will share the movie’s MPA rating ahead of time, but the feature presentation will remain a mystery until showtime.
