85347.title: League of Legends Worlds 26 - Finals in Cinema
85347.synopsis: The League of Legends World Championship Finals are back on the big screen! In this 2026 edition, 19 teams from around the world will compete for the title of World Champion, with the grand final broadcast live in theatres.

85350.title: Singh 2.0
85350.cast: Afroz Khan, Ritu Matharoo, Sukhman Gill

85351.title: Ash and Crayons
85351.synopsis: ASH AND CRAYONS is an intimate portrait of childhood resilience and hope amid the war in Ukraine.  The film follows seven children as they pursue their passions, support their families, build friendships, and continue moving forward with courage and determination.  While rooted in the experiences of Ukrainian children, the film speaks to a universal truth: that even in the face of devastation, the human spirit has an extraordinary capacity to endure, adapt and dream of a better tomorrow.

85358.title: The Holiday (RE26)
85358.synopsis: Iris (Kate Winslet) is in love with a man who is about to marry another woman. Across the globe, Amanda (Cameron Diaz), realizes the man she lives with has been unfaithful. Two women who have never met and live 6000 miles apart, find themselves in the exact same place. They meet online at a home exchange website and impulsively switch homes for the holiday. Iris moves into Amanda's L.A. house in sunny California as Amanda arrives in the snow covered English countryside. Shortly after arriving at their destinations, both women find the last thing either wants or expects: a new romance. Amanda is charmed by Iris' handsome brother Graham (Jude Law) and Iris, with inspiration provided by legendary screenwriter Arthur (Eli Wallach), mends her heart when she meets film composer Miles (Jack Black).

85359.title: Wild Horse Nine: Early Access Screening
85359.synopsis: Be among the first to see Martin McDonagh’s WILD HORSE NINE when you attend the Wild Horse Nine: Early Access Screening on October 30. “John Malkovich and Sam Rockwell are simply superb” (Deadline) as CIA agents facing a trust-testing mission from Santiago to Easter Island ahead of the 1973 coup in Chile. “See it with an audience… Wild Horse Nine is laugh out loud funny, brilliant and moving” (Variety).

85360.title: Tangles
85360.synopsis: A young woman is forced to return to the conservative small town where her bizarre family lives to take care of her mother, having to deal with the cruel reality of her mom's Alzheimer disease and become the daughter they need.
85360.cast: Abbi Jacobson, Bryan Cranston, Julia Louis-Dreyfus

85372.title: Once Upon a Time… in Hollywood
85372.synopsis: In 1969, aging TV star Rick Dalton (Leonardo DiCaprio) and his longtime stunt double Cliff Booth (Brad Pitt) struggle to hold on to their footing and friendship in a Hollywood that seems dead set on leaving them behind.

85373.title: Game
85373.synopsis: In late summer 1993, a tense and claustrophobic battle of wills and wits unfolds after aging raver David (Marc Bessant) steals a stash of money and drugs, then crashes his car deep in the woods. Trapped in the wreckage, injured and helpless, he hangs suspended between life and death. When a mysterious poacher (Jason Williamson) discovers him, no rescue comes?only a watchful, unsettling presence that seems intent on letting nature finish the job. As the hours stretch and the elements close in, survival hinges on outlasting both the wilderness and the predator at its edge.

85376.title: ZERO A.D.: The Birth of Christ Early Access Event
85376.synopsis: A brutal ruler fears a prophecy and orders the death of a child - one who will change history.

85377.title: The Mosquito Bowl: Fan Event Livestream Q&A with Director Peter Berg
85377.synopsis: Following the attack on Pearl Harbor, four of America's top college football stars set their fame aside to enlist in the Marines. As they prepare for the brutal invasion of Okinawa, they'll play in a legendary game featuring some of the greatest players in history -- a game that, for many, will be the last they ever play.

85379.title: Hail Mary
85379.synopsis:
The life of Madhuchandran, a school bus driver, is turned upside down 
when the Kerala Police reopens a 23-year-old case of a missing girl.

85387.title: Bunker
85387.synopsis: Follows a married couple of 17 years. The husband is an architect who accepts a controversial project to build a survivalist bunker for a tech billionaire. This decision leads his wife to question their marriage.
85387.cast: Javier Bardem, Penelope Cruz, Stephen Graham

85394.title: TheyDream
85394.synopsis: After twenty years chronicling his Puerto Rican family, a director and his mother face devastating losses. Through tears and laughter, they craft animations that bring their loved ones back to life, discovering that every act of creation is also an act of letting go.

85398.title: In Waves
85398.synopsis: Set against the sun-soaked surf culture of Southern California, IN WAVES, based on a true story, explores the joy of finding your soulmate, the courage it takes to live life to the fullest, and the enduring power of love to shape who we become and what we leave behind.

85399.title: Avedon
85399.synopsis: From world leaders to pop culture icons, and international supermodels, Richard Avedon's influence helped create the blueprint for our image-driven world. His photographs didn't just reflect culture, they shaped it.  AVEDON traces the life and legacy of an artist who used photography to reinvent the world around him. Drawing on unprecedented access to his personal archives--never-before-seen stills, intimate behind-the-lens footage, and new interviews with his closest collaborators--the film explores how his singular eye both reflected and reshaped the visual language of the 20th century, and why even the most iconic image is only half the story.

85401.title: Parkway Drive: HOME
85401.synopsis: After two decades of headlining festivals and arenas around the world, Australian metal band Parkway Drive return home to stage the most ambitious performance of their career. Reimagining their music with a full symphony orchestra at the Sydney Opera House, the band risks everything on a one-night-only event that challenges both their identity and their audience's expectations. As creative tensions rise and self-doubt surfaces, fans from across the globe arrive to witness history. Home is an intimate portrait of ambition, vulnerability and community, exploring what it means to evolve without losing the spirit that made you.
85401.cast: Jeff Ling, Luke Kilpatrick, Winston McCall

85402.title: The Last Temptation of Becky
85402.synopsis: Now a CIA field agent, Becky goes undercover in Poland to infiltrate a family running an inn at The Wolf's Lair, one of Hitler's WWII bunkers. When she learns the father, Wilhelm Reuss, plans to spark the Fourth Reich, Becky must stop him.
85402.cast: Kate Siegel, Lulu Wilson, Neil Patrick Harris

85408.title: Steps
85408.synopsis: Think you know Cinderella's 'evil' stepsisters? Think again. Sick of living in Cinderella's shadow, Lilith (Ali Wong) steals the Fairy Godmother (Bette Midler)'s magic wand and hijacks the Royal Ball with her sister Margot (Stephanie Hsu), breaking the Cinderella story as we know it and dooming the kingdom to the tyrannical rule of Priscilla (Nikki Glaser), a villainous schemer who swoops in and snatches the throne. Now, Lilith must team up with Cinderella (Amanda Seyfried) to fight biker trolls, outrun evil henchmen, and escape the Screaming Woods on an epic quest to save the kingdom, but most importantly, their relationship.
85408.cast: Ali Wong, Amanda Seyfried, Stephanie Hsu

85429.title: How to Rob a Bank: Early Access Screening
85429.synopsis: In HOW TO ROB A BANK, a crew of social media-savvy bank robbers broadcasts their daring heists, unaware that their growing viral fame has put them in the crosshairs of a veteran FBI agent and a brilliant software engineer. Despite the unlikely duo closing in, the crime ring pushes past their limits, putting everything on the line for their most ambitious heist yet.

85431.title: RBO - Nutcracker (2026)
85431.synopsis: Nothing says Christmas quite like The Nutcracker! The Royal Ballet celebrates the festive season with Peter Wright?s beloved ballet. Set to Tchaikovsky?s stunning score and with Julia Trevelyan Oman?s sumptuous designs, this festive classic is a treat for the whole family. *Re-release, filmed live December 10, 2025*

85438.title: Nuisance Bear
85438.synopsis:
For thousands of years, polar bears have migrated along the shores of Hudson Bay in northern Canada. Today, that ancient rhythm collides with a human world of tourism, surveillance, and control. Nuisance Bear immerses viewers in the experience of a polar bear forced to navigate tourists, wildlife officers, and hunters as climate change delays the freeze and pushes bears closer to human settlements. When a sacred predator is branded a 'nuisance,' it becomes unclear who truly belongs in this shared landscape.

Returning to Churchill, Manitoba--the self-styled "Polar Bear Capital of the World"--filmmakers Gabriela Osio Vanden and Jack Weisman expand their award-winning short into a feature guided by an Inuit narrator whose perspective resists simplification. Shot with striking intimacy and scale, the film observes bears that are constantly monitored, photographed, and redirected. In tracing this uneasy coexistence, Nuisance Bear becomes a meditation on how humans manage, commodify, and redefine wildlife--overturning the conventions of the nature documentary and reframing animals not as spectacle, but as active agents in a rapidly changing world.

85439.title: Gods Don't Give Gifts
85439.synopsis: On NiiroCradle, where bodies are disposable and consciousness has been commoditized, four characters collide with the horrifying consequences of humanity?s attempt to transcend the flesh.

85446.title: Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping Early Access
85446.synopsis: THE HUNGER GAMES: SUNRISE ON THE REAPING will revisit the world of Panem 24 years before the events of The Hunger Games, starting on the morning of the reaping of the 50th Hunger Games, also known as the Second Quarter Quell.

85447.title: American Sniper
85447.synopsis: U.S. Navy SEAL Chris Kyle is sent to Iraq with only one mission: to protect his brothers-in-arms. His pinpoint accuracy saves countless lives on the battlefield and, as stories of his courageous exploits spread, he earns the nickname 'Legend.' However, his reputation is also growing behind enemy lines, putting a price on his head and making him a prime target of insurgents. He is also facing a different kind of battle on the home front: striving to be a good husband and father from halfway around the world. Despite the danger, as well as the toll on his family at home, Chris serves through four harrowing tours of duty in Iraq, personifying the spirit of the SEAL creed to 'leave no one behind.' But upon returning to his wife, Taya Renae Kyle (Sienna Miller), and kids, Chris finds that it is the war he can't leave behind.

85452.title: Andrew Lloyd Webber's Starlight Express - Live On Stage
85452.cast: Jade Marvin, Jeevan Braich, Olivia Ringrose

85457.title: Heated Rivalry: Episode 1 & 2
85457.synopsis: Episode 1 - "Rookies": Hockey superstars Shane Hollander (Hudson Williams) and Ilya Rozanov (Connor Storrie) toe the thin ice between rivalry and something far more personal. Episode 2 - "Olympians": Shane and Ilya keep their secret fling alive while their growing connection is tested by personal and professional pressures.

85458.title: Heated Rivalry: Episode 3 & 4
85458.synopsis: Episode 3 - "Hunter": A hockey player’s high-stakes career collides with love when a chance meeting ignites a spark. Episode 4 - "Rose": A moment of unexpected vulnerability and a high-profile romance unleash a storm of turmoil for Shane and Ilya.

85459.title: Heated Rivalry: Episode 5 & 6
85459.synopsis: Episode 5 - "I'll Believe in Anything": Shane, Ilya, and Scott each face pivotal personal decisions. Episode 6 - "The Cottage": Shane and Ilya escape the spotlight for a rare moment of freedom.

85480.title: Zi
85480.synopsis: In Hong Kong, a young woman haunted by visions of her future self meets a stranger who changes the course of her night-and possibly her life.

85481.title: Mysaa
85481.synopsis: Unafraid of war and unwilling to stop until she finds that one answer. She carries no doubts. Only the ache of an answer she's searched her whole life.
85481.cast: Eshwari Rao, Rahul Ravindran, Rashmika Mandanna

85486.title: Mysaa (Hindi)
85486.synopsis: Unafraid of war and unwilling to stop until she finds that one answer. She carries no doubts. Only the ache of an answer she's searched her whole life.

85489.title: Exhibition on Screen: Renoir & Love
85489.synopsis:
Pierre-Auguste Renoir is one of the world's favourite artists; a founding member of the Impressionist movement and a constantly evolving artist, he is unmatched at depicting human connection. The National Gallery's blockbuster exhibition brings together vibrant masterpieces which explore love in all its forms, bringing colour and warmth into the cold winter months.

With exclusive access to this exciting new show, Exhibition on Screen will bring these world class works to cinema audiences, with close examination of the art and leading experts exploring the immense skill and influence of this master of colour and connection. Be transported back to a Parisian summer of love through the eyes of a true visionary. An unmissable opportunity to fall in love with Renoir this winter.

85490.title: A Long Winter
85490.synopsis: In 1951, high in Colorado's Rocky Mountains, Mike's world is thrown into uncertainty when his mother vanishes into the wilderness. Alongside his complicated father, and with their small mountain community rallying together against the unforgiving winter, Mike embarks on a search that leads him toward an unexpected journey of self-discovery, belonging and the quiet strength required to carry on.
85490.cast: Caitriona Balfe, Ebon Moss-Bachrach, Fred Hechinger

85497.title: Ek Onkar
85497.synopsis: Set against the backdrop of the 2012 Sikh Temple shooting in Oak Creek, Wisconsin, EK ONKAR weaves a story of intertwined fates and faiths. The film follows three lives: a former Marine who becomes a white supremacist, a seasoned police officer, and a troubled young Sikh man. As their paths collide, each grapples with personal trauma, strained relationships, and the search for purpose. A tragic event will ultimately shape their destinies. This powerful drama explores redemption, resilience, family, and the transformative power of faith and human connection.
85497.cast: Derek Casper, Jimmy Bacon, Parampal Singh

85509.title: Karaoke Murder
85509.synopsis: During a remote mountain pilgrimage with a group of neighbors, a former journalist is forced to reclaim her investigative instincts when a detested tycoon with an obsessive penchant for karaoke is forever silenced in the dark of the night. Stranded with nothing to feed on but paranoia, no one escapes becoming the prime suspect in this riveting murder mystery. Directed by Hoang Le, produced by 89s Group and F35 Studio, with an international release by 3388 Films.
85509.cast: Dai Nghia, Doan Thien An, Thanh Son

85516.title: Eternal Return
85516.synopsis: After losing her boyfriend in an accident, Cass is resigned to a life without love until she meets an enigmatic mapmaker who charts courses to imaginary places. Their fantastical adventure through London compels Cass to choose between the past she left behind and a future she never saw coming.
85516.cast: Kit Harington, Naomi Scott, Sonoya Mizuno

85522.title: Hadoota
85522.synopsis: Hadoota (Ahmed Helmy), a 40-year-old thug, can't remember the hiding place of a witness he kidnapped. Filled with mistaken identities, outrageous situations, romance, humour and heartfelt moments, SANJOG is designed as a complete Punjabi theatrical entertainer - a film that brings together the energy of a romantic comedy with the warmth and chaos of a family story.
announced.cast: Happy Raikoti, Jassi Gill

announced.title: Yeh Prem Mol Liya
announced.synopsis: A small-town boy chasing big dreams in Mumbai turns tradition on its head when he moves into his wife's home along with his entire family - forcing two clashing households to learn what true love, respect actually is. YEH PREM MOL LIYA is set to release in theatres worldwide on November 27th, 2026.
announced.cast: Ayushmann Khurrana, Sharvari Wagh

announced.title: Rehearsals for a Revolution
announced.synopsis: Through five portraits of her loved ones, each a figure of resistance, Pegah Ahangarani traces the intimate story of her life. Drawing on her personal archives, family videos, images of demonstrations, press articles, and sound recordings, she traverses more than forty years of Iranian history. From the first stirrings of 1979 to the war that erupted in 2026, she weaves a dialogue between individual memory and collective history, painting a portrait of a country marked by political repression but relentlessly driven by the desire for freedom and the hope of revolution.

announced.title: Gods Don't Give Gifts
announced.synopsis: On NiiroCradle, where bodies are disposable and consciousness has been commoditized, four characters collide with the horrifying consequences of humanity?s attempt to transcend the flesh.
announced.cast: Grimes, Mark Lewis, Victor Tapia

announced.title: Love Actually (HFS26)
announced.synopsis: Follows the lives of eight very different couples in dealing with their love lives in various loosely interrelated tales all set during a frantic month before Christmas in London, England.

announced.title: Eternal Return
announced.synopsis: After losing her boyfriend in an accident, Cass is resigned to a life without love until she meets an enigmatic mapmaker who charts courses to imaginary places. Their fantastical adventure through London compels Cass to choose between the past she left behind and a future she never saw coming.
announced.cast: Kit Harington, Naomi Scott, Sonoya Mizuno

announced.title: Above the Below
announced.synopsis: In this tense thriller, three astronauts (Idris Elba, Caitlin FitzGerald, and Hero Fiennes Tiffin) return to Earth only to discover their fight for survival has just begun. Directed by Idris Elba and Martin Owen, the film follows the crew after their damaged spacecraft is violently hurled through the atmosphere and plunges into the depths of the ocean. With oxygen rapidly running out and hope fading, they are forced to make an unthinkable choice: who will risk everything to reach the surface...and who will remain behind with the wreckage below.
announced.cast: Idris Elba

announced.title: Dr. Seuss' How The Grinch Stole Christmas
announced.synopsis: The curmudgeonly recluse Grinch, who hates Christmas, becomes annoyed with the out-of-control Christmas festivities in Whoville, the town lying below his cave dwelling on Mt. Crumpit. But after the Grinch conspires to deprive the Who's of their favorite holiday by sneaking into town on Christmas eve to steal everything associated with the holiday, he learns that the spirit of Christmas goes much deeper than tinsel and toys.

announced.title: Flavia Girl Detective
announced.synopsis: Amateur detective. Master poisoner. Eleven years old. When Flavia finds a dead body at her family's decaying British manor house and her father is accused of murder, she dives into her own wild and fearless investigation, unearthing long-held family secrets and pitting herself against the true murderer. A little genius goes a long way. Based on the internationally renowned and New York Times bestselling The Flavia de Luce mystery book series.
announced.cast: Jonathan Pryce, Martin Freeman, Molly Belle Wright

announced.title: Alias Rukmini
announced.synopsis: Krishna writes edgy and raunchy books under his wife Rukmini's name as a pseudonym, concealing his identity as the true author behind the provocative novels.
announced.cast: Aafiya Sayed, Nithiin

announced.title: Vrushakarma
announced.synopsis: In a desperate quest to decode ancient cave carvings, a treasure hunter hungry for untold riches, an obsessed archaeologist, and a devoted history student race against time to unravel a prophecy tied to royal lineage and the impending apocalypse, confronting the forces of destiny and evil along the way.
announced.cast: Jayaram, Meenakshi Chaudhary, Naga Chaitanya

announced.title: The Fox
announced.synopsis: In this darkly comic folktale, an affable foxhunter encounters a talking Fox who offers him an opportunity to transform his fiancee into the perfect woman.
announced.cast: Emily Browning, Jai Courtney, Olivia Colman

announced.title: Popiwa
announced.synopsis: Three humble friends discover a lost monkey, and when they return it in exchange for a generous reward, their lives change overnight. Suddenly rich, they dive into a world of luxury, wild adventures, and hilarious situations that put their friendship to the test.
announced.cast: Carlos Cruz, Luis Polonia, Papi Rosswil

announced.title: Many Many Happy Returns
announced.cast: Boban Alumoodan, Kalidas Jayaram, Sosamma Jacob

announced.title: Behemoth!
announced.synopsis: A gifted cellist, Alex Serian (Pedro Pascal), returns home to Los Angeles after 20 years on the road.  Music, which has been the constant, all-consuming river of his life, begins to carry Alex on an adventure that will change him forever.
announced.cast: Eva Victor, Olivia Wilde, Pedro Pascal

announced.title: Nuisance Bear
announced.synopsis:
For thousands of years, polar bears have migrated along the shores of Hudson Bay in northern Canada. Today, that ancient rhythm collides with a human world of tourism, surveillance, and control. Nuisance Bear immerses viewers in the experience of a polar bear forced to navigate tourists, wildlife officers, and hunters as climate change delays the freeze and pushes bears closer to human settlements. When a sacred predator is branded a 'nuisance,' it becomes unclear who truly belongs in this shared landscape.

Returning to Churchill, Manitoba--the self-styled "Polar Bear Capital of the World"--filmmakers Gabriela Osio Vanden and Jack Weisman expand their award-winning short into a feature guided by an Inuit narrator whose perspective resists simplification. Shot with striking intimacy and scale, the film observes bears that are constantly monitored, photographed, and redirected. In tracing this uneasy coexistence, Nuisance Bear becomes a meditation on how humans manage, commodify, and redefine wildlife--overturning the conventions of the nature documentary and reframing animals not as spectacle, but as active agents in a rapidly changing world.

announced.title: Bad Santa
announced.synopsis: Two con men masquerade as Santa Claus and an elf, knocking off shopping malls. But then they meet an 8-year-old boy, who unintentionally reminds them about the true meaning of Christmas.

announced.title: The Friend's House is Here
announced.synopsis: In Tehran's underground art scene, Pari, a theater director, and Hanna, a dancer, are roommates, best friends, actors, and professional partners, navigating rehearsals, performances, and the quiet rituals of everyday life--until their secret circle is discovered. Shot covertly but far removed from familiar portrayals of Iran, directors Maryam Ataei and Hossein Keshavarz blur the boundaries between theatrical performance and lived experience, crafting a luminous portrait of sisterhood where art becomes inseparable from life and even the smallest creative choices can become acts of resistance. Winner of the US Dramatic Special Jury Award for Ensemble Cast at the 2026 Sundance Film Festival.
announced.cast: Hana Mana, Mahshad Bahraminejad

announced.title: Gremlins
announced.synopsis: With its Christmas lights and dusting of snow, Kingston Falls is an idyllic small town--until the gremlins take over. A father returns from Chinatown with an unusual pet, a Mogwai--a gift for his son. The rules are simple: Keep your Mogwai away from water, bright lights and, most importantly, never--never--feed him after midnight. But the rules are inadvertently broken, and the consequences multiply at an alarming rate.

announced.title: November 1963
announced.synopsis: The story of the Killing of a President as told by Joseph Giancana, who was with his brother, Sam Giancana during those days. Written by their nephew and told in real time about the underbelly that pulled off this crime.
announced.cast: Dermot Mulroney, John Travolta, Robert Carlyle

announced.title: The Gallerist
announced.synopsis: A gallerist, driven by a desperate desire for success, hatches a scheme to cover up a dead man as an extraordinary art piece at a pretentious Miami art fair.
announced.cast: Jenna Ortega, Natalie Portman, Sterling K. Brown

announced.title: Elf
announced.synopsis: A human baby raised as an elf. A city where no one remembers the true meaning of Christmas. Will Ferrell (Saturday Night Live, Superstar) stars as Buddy, a human raised in the North Pole to be an elf. After wreaking havoc in the elf community due to his size, Buddy heads to New York City to find his place in the world, and track down his father. But life in the big city is not all sugarplums and candy canes. His father is a 'Scrooge' and his eight-year-old stepbrother doesn't believe in Santa. Even the snowmen aren't friendly in New York. In fact, they don't even speak. Worst of all, everyone has forgotten the true meaning of Christmas, and it's up to Buddy and his simple elf ways to win over his family, realize his destiny and, ultimately, save Christmas for New York and the world. Directed by John Favreau (Swingers), Elf is a warm-hearted Christmas comedy written by David Berenbaum.

announced.title: Scrooged
announced.synopsis: High-spirited high jinks on Christmas Eve put Frank Cross (Bill Murray) in a ghostly time warp in this hilarious take-off of Charles Dickens' A Christmas Carol. Cross, who has made the meteoric rise from the depths of the mail room to TV network president, is mean, nasty, uncaring, unforgiving and has a sadistic sense of humor - perfect qualities for a modern-day Scrooge. Before the night is over, he'll be visited by a maniacal New York cab driver from the past, a present-day fairy who’s into pratfalls and, finally, a ghoulish, seven-foot headless messenger from the future.

announced.title: Violent Night 2
announced.synopsis:
If you're nice, you get presents from the Big Guy. If you're naughty, you get justice.

David Harbour reprises his role as Santa Claus in a propulsive new chapter in yuletide mayhem from 87North--the powerhouse producers of Bullet Train, John Wick, The Fall Guy, Atomic Blonde and the Nobody franchise--and returning action director Tommy Wirkola.

In 2022's bare-knuckle holiday sensation, VIOLENT NIGHT, an embittered Santa, armed with lethal combat skills, took out a team of mercenaries to rescue a girl and her family. Now, not-so-jolly Saint Nick suits up again to take on a ruthless gangster (Emmy and Golden Globe nominee Jared Harris) terrorizing the merchants of the Silver Bell Mall.

But when Santa forgets the true meaning of Christmas, he finds himself in the heart of a lively mall community in desperate need of his help. Sapped of his magic, he'll need another way to take on the goons threatening the mall, and time is running out. Santa has to rediscover his faith in goodness and call in some last-minute reinforcements from the one person no baddie wants to tangle with: Mrs. Claus (Emmy and Golden Globe nominee Kristen Bell). 

Along with David Harbour, Jared Harris and Kristen Bell, the dynamic cast includes Emmy winning screen legend Joe Pantoliano (The Last of Us, The Sopranos), Daniela Melchior (Fast X, Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3), Andrew Bachelor (Greenland, The Walking Dead), and AEW professional wrestler Maxwell Friedman (The Iron Claw, Happy Gilmore 2).

VIOLENT NIGHT 2 is directed by returning filmmaker Tommy Wirkola and produced again by 87North founders Kelly McCormick and David Leitch. The film's returning screenwriters are Pat Casey and Josh Miller. Violent Night 2 will be released by Universal Pictures.
announced.cast: David Harbour, Jared Harris, Kristen Bell

announced.title: Game
announced.synopsis: In late summer 1993, a tense and claustrophobic battle of wills and wits unfolds after aging raver David (Marc Bessant) steals a stash of money and drugs, then crashes his car deep in the woods. Trapped in the wreckage, injured and helpless, he hangs suspended between life and death. When a mysterious poacher (Jason Williamson) discovers him, no rescue comes?only a watchful, unsettling presence that seems intent on letting nature finish the job. As the hours stretch and the elements close in, survival hinges on outlasting both the wilderness and the predator at its edge.

announced.title: The Polar Express
announced.synopsis: On Christmas Eve, a young boy embarks on a magical adventure to the North Pole on the Polar Express, while learning about friendship, bravery, and the spirit of Christmas.

announced.title: The Holiday (RE26)
announced.synopsis: Iris (Kate Winslet) is in love with a man who is about to marry another woman. Across the globe, Amanda (Cameron Diaz), realizes the man she lives with has been unfaithful. Two women who have never met and live 6000 miles apart, find themselves in the exact same place. They meet online at a home exchange website and impulsively switch homes for the holiday. Iris moves into Amanda's L.A. house in sunny California as Amanda arrives in the snow covered English countryside. Shortly after arriving at their destinations, both women find the last thing either wants or expects: a new romance. Amanda is charmed by Iris' handsome brother Graham (Jude Law) and Iris, with inspiration provided by legendary screenwriter Arthur (Eli Wallach), mends her heart when she meets film composer Miles (Jack Black).

announced.title: Tender Loving Care
announced.synopsis: Palme d'Or winner and Academy Award nominee Mike Leigh returns with his next feature film, continuing his insightful exploration of the contemporary world. With his distinctive cinematic voice, he once again delves into themes that challenge and resonate with modern audiences.
announced.cast: Kate O'Flynn, Marion Bailey, Paul Jesson

announced.title: Jean-Michel Basquiat
announced.synopsis: Jean-Michel Basquiat is a reclamation of what has been lost in the legacy of a globally renowned artist. Through untold memories from close friends and family, never-before-seen works, and rare archival imagery, this film demystifies the story of Basquiat and discovers the man behind it all, Jean-Michel.

announced.title: Rose
announced.synopsis: In the turmoil of the Thirty-Years' War, a mysterious soldier appears in a secluded Protestant village claiming to be heir to a long-abandoned manor. His quest for recognition and acceptance are complicated by his secret: under a false identity, false name, and pretense of a false gender, he has made his way to the village. But to achieve her goals, Rose, as the soldier is actually called, will stop at nothing.
announced.cast: Caro Braun, Sandra Huller

announced.title: Imka Em Anukoledhu
announced.cast: Akshay Lagusani, Keyuri

announced.title: The Debut
announced.synopsis: When Mona Friedman is cast in a bit part at a small community theater, she transforms from a shy, unassuming housewife into a zealous method actor willing to do anything to protect the artistic integrity of her marginal role--even if it means waging war against the show's domineering director.
announced.cast: Halle Bailey, Julianne Moore, Paul Giamatti

announced.title: Secret Lives of Baba Segi's Wives
announced.synopsis: A rich patriarch's delicate family falls apart when his youngest of four wives cannot have a child.
announced.cast: Bimbo Ademoye, Mercy Aigbe, Odunlade Adekola

announced.title: Ink
announced.synopsis: The film is based on the Tony-nominated play by multi-Olivier award-winning playwright and screenwriter James Graham. The film is an explosive cinematic rollercoaster about a group of visionaries and misfits who had an idea for a new kind of news -- one that would give the people what they want and would change the face of the world we live in today.
announced.cast: Claire Foy, Guy Pearce, Jack O'Connell

announced.title: Andre Rieu's 2026 Christmas Concert: Let it Snow!
announced.synopsis: Known to millions as `The King of Waltz?, Andre Rieu is the world?s leading pop classical artist and consistently appears on the worldwide list of highest-grossing touring artists.

announced.title: Gradiva, La
announced.synopsis: A class of high school students travels to Pompeii to discover ruins and bodies petrified by Vesuvius. The trip becomes a rare moment when the force of youth meets a world frozen in time. Their desires start to surface with unexpected intensity, leading them toward an irreversible fracture.
announced.cast: Colas Quignard, Suzanne Gerin

announced.title: The Angry Birds Movie 3
announced.synopsis: This holiday season, one angry bird will face his greatest challenge yet, surviving fatherhood? while saving the world!
announced.cast: Jason Sudeikis, Josh Gad

announced.title: King
announced.synopsis: Mentor and disciple embark on a perilous journey, pushing their survival skills to the limit against overwhelming odds and unforgiving environments.
announced.cast: Shah Rukh Khan

announced.title: Dada
announced.synopsis: A stylish and uncompromising underworld don aggressively conquers the lawless Mumbai streets, weaponizing his fierce trademark justice to systematically dismantle a lethal corporate criminal syndicate.
announced.cast: Kajal Aggarwal, Manchu Manoj, Nbk

announced.title: Athi Manoharam
announced.cast: Meera Jasmine, Mohan Lal

announced.title: Mr. Irrelevant
announced.synopsis: Mr. Irrelevant is the inspiring true story of John Tuggle (David Corenswet), the last player selected in the last round of the 1983 NFL draft by the New York Giants. A true underdog, Tuggle defied expectations on the field and off for his then first-year head coach, Bill Parcells (Michael Shannon), his newfound love (Isabel May), and his team, proving that remarkable hope and perseverance can transcend even the greatest challenges.
announced.cast: David Corenswet, Michael Shannon

announced.title: Werwulf
announced.synopsis: Witness Robert Eggers’ most visceral and haunting experience yet. Focus Features presents WERWULF, a harrowing tale of devotion, damnation and the devil within.

announced.title: Coward
announced.synopsis: Set at the height of World War I in the shadows of the Belgian trenches, Lukas Dhont's COWARD unfolds as an epic, intimate journey of youthful self discovery through love, art, and survival. Pierre arrives at the front lines as a young soldier eager to find his footing in a world consumed by violence. Everything changes when he meets Francis, a kindred spirit whose vision of staging a front-line theater show unlocks a world Pierre never knew existed. What begins as a fleeting escape from the harsh reality of the trenches soon blossoms into a tender, emotional love story, anchored by the undeniable chemistry of breakout actors Emmanuel Macchia and Valentin Campagne. As the world burns around them, their stage becomes a sanctuary of innocence and devotion. COWARD beautifully explores the fine line between fear and fortitude for soldiers in search of a promised glory, ultimately asking: when the world demands brutality, is walking away for love the truest act of bravery?
announced.cast: Emmanuel Macchia, Valentin Campagne

announced.title: Artificial
announced.cast: Andrew Garfield, Monica Barbaro, Yura Borisov

announced.title: Jumanji: Open World
announced.synopsis: This Christmas, Dwayne Johnson, Kevin Hart, Jack Black, and Karen Gillan are reunited in Jumanji: Open World, the hilarious final installment of the globally beloved action-adventure trilogy. Our heroes have escaped the perilous jungles of Jumanji before, but this time Jumanji breaks free of its console, unleashing its chaos into our world.
announced.cast: Dwayne Johnson, Jack Black, Kevin Hart

announced.title: Look Back
announced.synopsis:
Confident grade-schooler Fujino draws comics for her school newspaper, earning the admiration of her classmates. When her artwork is surpassed by her reclusive peer Kyomoto, she becomes obsessed with honing her skills, eventually burning out and giving up drawing altogether. But when Fujino finally meets Kyomoto, she discovers that Kyomoto has been her devoted fan all along. Bound by their shared passion, they spend irreplaceable years drawing manga together until a fateful event changes their lives forever.

From Palme d'Or winner Hirokazu Koreeda, Look Back is a love letter to the artistic process, hand-written in ink on paper, and a meditation on how mutual pursuit of a craft creates the deepest etches in our memory.
announced.cast: Miyu Sasaki, Ryo Ikeda

announced.title: Pendulum
announced.synopsis: Married couple Patrick (Gordon-Levitt) and Abigail (Dynevor) travel to a secluded New Mexico retreat seeking healing after a traumatic event. But as Abigail falls deeper under the influence of the retreat's enigmatic leader (Weaver), Patrick begins to suspect something far more sinister lurks beneath the group's spiritual promises. As paranoia spirals into terror, the couple uncovers a horrifying truth that may consume them both before they can escape.
announced.cast: Joseph Gordon-Levitt, Norman Reedus, Phoebe Dynevor

announced.title: Japon - lumiere d'automne - Les aventuriers voyageurs
announced.synopsis: Immerse yourself in the heart of a fascinating country where ancient traditions and modernity coexist in perfect harmony. From bustling metropolises like Tokyo to serene places like Kyoto, this journey unveils the many facets of the Japanese archipelago. Through encounters and discoveries, the film leads us to iconic sites steeped in history and emotion, such as Hiroshima and the sacred island of Miyajima, as well as to more peaceful regions, including the majestic landscapes of the Japanese Alps. Between ancient temples, ultramodern cities, and breathtaking panoramas bathed in the colors of autumn, our adventurers Serge and Johanne offer a sensitive and authentic perspective on Japan.

announced.title: Everybody Digs Bill Evans
announced.synopsis: June 1961, New York. Legendary jazz pianist Bill Evans has found his musical voice and created the perfect trio, including bass player Scott LaFaro, his musical soulmate. A residency at New York's Village Vanguard culminates in the live taping of two of the greatest jazz records of all time in one day. Days later, LaFaro dies tragically in a car crash. Numb with grief, Evans stops playing for the first time since childhood. This is the story of what happened next for one of the most influential and gifted figures in 20th Century music. Grant Gee won Best Director at the 2026 Berlin International Film Festival.
announced.cast: Anders Danielsen Lie, Bill Pullman, Laurie Metcalf

announced.title: Hurricanna
announced.synopsis: In the hours surrounding a glamorous appearance at a championship boxing match, supermodel Anna Nicole Smith, her psychiatrist, and her lover form a disastrous trio and descend towards chaos.
announced.cast: Holly Hunter, Mark Duplass, Sylvia Hoeks

announced.title: The Liberation
announced.synopsis: Rita (Coon), a woman in midlife haunted by the weight of her past, encounters magnetic young spiritual leader Ricki (James) and leaves her family to follow her to an all-female commune. But when her daughters Ella (Ramsey) and Jo (Young) arrive unexpectedly and become drawn into the group's seductive world, Rita is forced to choose between the family she left behind and the life she believes can save her.
announced.cast: Bella Ramsey, Carrie Coon, Lily James

announced.title: January 12 Vidudala
announced.synopsis:
Two Army officers and best friends, Venkat Reddy and Bal Reddy are very efficient in handling crises situation regarding national defense. when Bal Reddy returns to his native village, he encounters unexpected rift in within a family divided by tradition, identity, and pride. Venkat reddy steps in to heal the growing rift, but faces unimaginable difficulties in process.
This setup against the vibrant backdrop of Rayalaseema, the story blends action, romance, humor, and family drama sacrifice, and the enduring power of love, friendship,
announced.cast: Keerthy Suresh, Nandamuri Kalyan Ram, Venkatesh Daggubati

announced.title: River
announced.synopsis:
The sun is down.  The boat is dead.  There's no cell service.  And there's someone standing, staring, from both shores.  Written and directed by Joshua Giuliano, RIVER stars Jane Levy (Evil Dead), Jessica Rothe (Happy Death Day) and Max Mattern (Devil in Disguise: John Wayne Gacy) as three estranged siblings who reunite in their hometown after the death of their father. As they set out to scatter his ashes at his favorite spot on a remote river, the trip devolves into a waking nightmare. Dane DiLiegro (Prey) also stars in the film.

Currently with a 94% critics rating on Rotten Tomatoes, RIVER was acquired by Universal Pictures and Blumhouse Atomic Monster following an electrifying launch at Midnight Madness at the Toronto International Film Festival. This release establishes a meaningful, new collaboration between Universal Pictures, Blumhouse Atomic Monster, Independent Film Company and Shudder, bringing them together for the expanded theatrical release of Joshua Giuliano's debut feature. 

Universal Pictures, Blumhouse Atomic Monster and Independent Film Company present RIVER, a Shudder Original Production, in association with Upgrade. RIVER is produced by Spooky Pictures' Steven Schneider and Eat the Cat's Nick Antosca and Alex Hedlund. The film is executive produced by Allegheny Image Factory's Jeffrey Tinnell and Robert Tinnell, Upgrade's Matt Brodlie and Jonathan Kier, Ben Ross and Blumhouse Atomic Monster's Jason Blum.
announced.cast: Jane Levy, Jessica Rothe, Max Mattern

announced.title: Bunker
announced.synopsis: Follows a married couple of 17 years. The husband is an architect who accepts a controversial project to build a survivalist bunker for a tech billionaire. This decision leads his wife to question their marriage.
announced.cast: Javier Bardem, Penelope Cruz, Stephen Graham

announced.title: Fing!
announced.synopsis: Librarians Mr. and Mrs. Meek indulge their demanding daughter Myrtle's every wish. When she wants a Fing, they search deep in the jungle. After finding one, Myrtle faces off against a Viscount who wants the rare creature.
announced.cast: Iona Bell, Penelope Wilton, Taika Waititi

announced.title: Tangles
announced.synopsis: A young woman is forced to return to the conservative small town where her bizarre family lives to take care of her mother, having to deal with the cruel reality of her mom's Alzheimer disease and become the daughter they need.
announced.cast: Abbi Jacobson, Bryan Cranston, Julia Louis-Dreyfus

announced.title: Children of Blood and Bone
announced.synopsis: In the epic fantasy world of Orïsha, a young woman goes on a quest to reclaim the magic that was violently stolen from her people. She and her brother ally with the daughter and son of the king to fight back against his brutal rule. Directed by Gina Prince-Bythewood, CHILDREN OF BLOOD AND BONE features a stellar cast including Thuso Mbedu, Damson Idris, Amandla Stenberg, Tosin Cole, featuring Academy Award® nominee Cynthia Erivo, Lashana Lynch, Zackary Momoh, Richard Mofe-Damijo, Academy Award®  nominee Chiwetel Ejiofor, Academy Award®  winner Regina King, with Idris Elba and Academy Award®  winner Viola Davis.
announced.cast: Amandla Stenberg, Thuso Mbedu

announced.title: The Beekeeper 2
announced.synopsis: Now a wanted man, former government assassin Adam Clay continues his vendetta against those who wronged him.
announced.cast: Jason Statham

announced.title: The Choice
announced.synopsis: THE CHOICE is a documentary about survival, grief, forgiveness, and the extraordinary human capacity to choose hope in the face of devastation.

announced.title: Exhibition on Screen: Renoir & Love
announced.synopsis:
Pierre-Auguste Renoir is one of the world's favourite artists; a founding member of the Impressionist movement and a constantly evolving artist, he is unmatched at depicting human connection. The National Gallery's blockbuster exhibition brings together vibrant masterpieces which explore love in all its forms, bringing colour and warmth into the cold winter months.

With exclusive access to this exciting new show, Exhibition on Screen will bring these world class works to cinema audiences, with close examination of the art and leading experts exploring the immense skill and influence of this master of colour and connection. Be transported back to a Parisian summer of love through the eyes of a true visionary. An unmissable opportunity to fall in love with Renoir this winter.

announced.title: Air Bud Returns
announced.synopsis: A grieving 12-year-old boy finds his dad?s old VHS tape and befriends a golden retriever in his new year.  Together, they chase basketball dreams, rally underdogs, and discover what it means to play with heart.
announced.cast: Edwin Lee Gibson, Tracy Ifeachor, Tyler Labine

announced.title: Lords of War
announced.synopsis: Nicolas Cage reprises his role as Yuri Orlov, the world's most notorious arms dealer, who discovers he has a son, a ruthless mercenary bent on surpassing his father by building a private army and exploiting America's wars in the Middle East. Thrust into a deadly battle for legacy, their fierce rivalry is fueled by power, ambition, and betrayal - with the global arms trade hanging in the balance.
announced.cast: Nicolas Cage

announced.title: Animal Friends
announced.synopsis: Live-action hybrid road trip adventure.
announced.cast: Jason Momoa, Ryan Reynolds

announced.title: The Third Parent
announced.synopsis: Based on the viral "creepypasta" series of internet-based stories from writer Elias Witherow, The Third Parent takes place amidst a Fourth of July celebration when a disturbing figure named Tommy Taffy emerges, disguising himself as a human to infiltrate a suburban neighborhood and impose authoritarian rule over an unsuspecting family.
announced.cast: Crispin Glover, Rob Lowe

announced.title: A Long Winter
announced.synopsis: In 1951, high in Colorado's Rocky Mountains, Mike's world is thrown into uncertainty when his mother vanishes into the wilderness. Alongside his complicated father, and with their small mountain community rallying together against the unforgiving winter, Mike embarks on a search that leads him toward an unexpected journey of self-discovery, belonging and the quiet strength required to carry on.
announced.cast: Caitriona Balfe, Ebon Moss-Bachrach, Fred Hechinger

announced.title: Clarissa
announced.synopsis: Based on Mrs. Dalloway. Follows a Lagos society wife preparing for a party while reflecting on her youth and the choices that led her to marry a respected man instead of her poet boyfriend.
announced.cast: Ayo Edebiri, David Oyelowo, Sophie Okonedo

announced.title: INDE les Mysteres du Gange - Les aventuriers voyageurs
announced.synopsis: After captivating audiences with their Italian saga, Michele and Martin radically change scenery to immerse themselves in the intensity of Northern India. From the vibrant energy of Delhi to the sacred banks of the Ganges, and on to the breathtaking panoramas of the Himalayas, they reveal an India that is both vibrant and profoundly human. Amidst flamboyant colors, age-old traditions, and the seething energy of the streets, the journey also offers moments of tranquility and pure emotion. Enchanting ceremonies, unforgettable encounters, majestic temples, and authentic scenes of daily life: this new film invites you to see, feel, and experience India? in a new way.
